texts.text:
<这里……看起来像是某种商店……>
 <This place... looks like some kind of store...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
这里到底在卖什么？不对，应该说，这里为什么会有东西可卖？
 What exactly are they selling here? No, actually, why's anything being sold here in the first place?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
毕竟这里是百货商店嘛～
 I mean, it's a department store~
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
Grand Magasin……百货商店本就是无数方寸之地为逐利而彼此簇拥之所。
 Grand Magasin... A department store is, by nature, a place where a myriad little squares crowd upon one another in pursuit of profit.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
想知道得更详细些，看来我们得四处看——
 I suppose we'll have to look around if we want to learn anything more in detai—
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
诶？什么动静？
 Wha? What was that?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text: 那到底是什么？！ What is that?!
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text: 不知道，但不管是什么，那东西都大得吓人…… I don't know, but whatever it is, something huge...
texts.speaker:
格里高尔
 Gregor

texts.text:
……从上方坠落下来了。
 ... has plummeted from above.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
好险。要是我们再往旁边靠近几步……恐怕就会遭到猛烈冲击。
 That was close. We would have sustained a severe impact... had we moved a few steps closer to the side.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
那似乎是……一大团纠缠在一起的人类躯体。不过遗骸损毁得过于严重，已经无法分辨出任何个体的形状。
 It appears to be... a huge mass of human bodies tangled together, though the remains are far too severely mutilated to discern any individual forms.
texts.speaker:
浮士德
 Faust

texts.text:
掉下来个大家伙。这次应该能捡到不少好东西。希望那些顾客花过不少眼球。
 A big one dropped. Might be plenty worth salvaging this time. Hope the customers were heavy eyeball-spenders.
texts.speaker:
绝望的顾客
 Desperate Customer

texts.text:
该死，我没有空瓶了！喂，你上个季度从我这里借了三个，打算什么时候还？！
 Damn it, I'm out of empty bottles! Hey, you borrowed three from me last season. When are you going to pay me back?!
texts.speaker:
穷困潦倒的顾客
 Destitute Customer

texts.text:
滚开！这个季度的新货全都……全都是我的。谁也别想抢！
 Fuck off! This season's new drop is all... all mine. No one else's!
texts.speaker:
急不可耐的顾客
 Impatient Customer

texts.text:
从天而降的那堆东西，原来是一具具早已血肉模糊、无法辨认的尸体。尸身之间的缝隙中，闪烁着如阳光般明亮而奇异的金色光芒。
 The pile that fell from the sky turns out to be corpses, mangled beyond all recognition. A curious golden glow, bright like sunlight, winks through the gaps between the bodies.

那些想必就是广播中提到的“顾客”的人，正拼命在尸堆间翻找，争抢着一切能拿到手的东西。
 The people I assume to be the "customers" mentioned in the announcement are desperately scrambling among the corpses, snatching up whatever they could find.

我们可否暂歇片刻？
 Might we rest our steps awhile?
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
<怎么了，前面有什么东西吗？>
 <Why, do you see anything up ahead?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
此事尚待商榷……
 That remains a subject to be discussed...
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
李箱一边握紧又松开手掌，一边望着我们继续说道。
 Yi Sang continued, clenching and unclenching his hand as he regarded us.

我一直有种奇异之感……想来并非我一人臆想。这便是我想与诸位商议之事。
 I have been set upon by this odd sensation... that which could not be a lone ideation of mine. This is the subject I wished to discuss with you.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
我是说……嗯，这确实很难不注意到。我们所有人都变弱了，就像当初刚和但丁签订契约时一样。
 I mean... Yeah, it's kinda hard to ignore. We've all grown weaker, like what happened to us when we first entered into that contract with Dante.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
……这很可能并非永久性现象。你们身体能力的衰退，大概源于西西弗百货的独特性质。
 ... This is likely not a permanent phenomenon. It is probable that the deterioration of your physical prowess is owed to the unique characteristic of the Grand Magasin Sisyphe.
texts.speaker:
浮士德
 Faust

texts.text:
问题出在此处空间本身？
 An issue with the very space of this place?
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
正确。即便我们是通过自杀贩卖机等间接方式进入西西弗，也无法改变我们已作为百货商店的“顾客”，进入了另一种存在状态这一事实。因此，我们在现象层面所认知的身体，必然已依照此地涉及“暗影”与“象征”的规则完成重构——
 Correct. Entering Sisyphe through indirect means, such as the Suicide Vending Machine, does not change the fact that we have entered another state of existence as "customers" of the department store. Ergo, our bodies as we perceive them in the phenomenal sense must have been reconstructed according to the rules of this place, which involves the Shadowed and the Symbolic—
texts.speaker:
浮士德
 Faust

texts.text:
等、等一下！
 H-hold on!
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
所以简单来说，是这个地方让我们变弱了，等出去之后就会恢复正常，对吧？
 So you're basically sayin' that this place is to blame for making us weaker, and we're gonna get back to normal once we're out, am I right?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
……是的。
 ... Yes.
texts.speaker:
浮士德
 Faust

texts.text:
嗯～那么，与其等人继续解释，或是绞尽脑汁想办法变强……
 Hmm~ Then rather than waiting for more explanation or brainstorming for ways to get stronger...
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
还是赶紧找到默尔，然后离开这里最好。
 Best we find Meur and get out of this place, chop-chop.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
难得大家意见一致。眼下的最高优先事项是找到默尔索；在完成这一首要目标前，有关这一现象的情报暂且搁置。
 Happy to have a consensus for once. Our highest priority at the moment is locating Meursault; we best table any intelligence pertaining to this phenomenon until that primary objective is accomplished.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
那要是碰上战斗呢？有什么打算吗？
 And if we run into fights? Any plans for that?
texts.speaker:
格里高尔
 Gregor

texts.text:
*呼* 就算我们变成了C.W.，杀一两个W.C.也不成问题。
 *puff* Killing a W.C. or two won't be a problem even if we've become C.W.
texts.speaker:
良秀
 Ryōshū

texts.text:
她说，就算我们变成了“孱弱蠢货”，杀一两个“游荡顾客”也不成问题……
 Killing a wandering customer or two won't be a problem even if we've become confused wimps, she says...
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
<好了，就按罗佳说的，先去找默尔索吧。>
 <You know what, let's just go find Meursault like Rodya said.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
真是令人意外……
 Surprise, surprise...

……你是谁？
 ... Who are you?
texts.speaker:
格里高尔
 Gregor

texts.text:
你们这群人运气可真不错，不是吗？
 You people are awfully lucky, aren't you?

看看那一地血肉！大概是从六楼上下掉下来的。这堆东西能让这里在一段时间里成为远近闻名的黄金坠落点。
 Look at that gory mess! Must've fallen from the sixth floor, give or take. This pile'll make this spot famous as a prime drop zone for a while.

……阁下是在同我们说话吗？
 ... Might you be talking to us?
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
你们怎么才来？我可是一天到晚都在焦急地等你们！
 What took you so long? I've been anxiously waiting for you 'round the clock!

等我们？你他妈为什么要……？
 For us? Why the hell would you...?
texts.speaker:
希斯克利夫
 Heathcliff

texts.text: 先不说别的，刚才从上面掉下来的那些……不是人类的尸体吗……？还有，那些人究竟在翻找什么……？ In any case, aren't those... human bodies that just fell from above...? And what're those people even scavenging...?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text: 她竟然说是人类！哎呀，你还真是异想天开，不是吗？那些可是顾客。 Human, she says! Oh, you're positively whimsical, aren't you? Those were customers.
至于那些翻找的人，他们听见砰的一声，就全聚过来，想捞到什么算什么。你也知道，这里的日子可不好过。 As for the scavengers, they heard a thud, so they've gathered up to try to get anything they can. Life's pretty rough in here, you know.

她走了。
 She's gone.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<赶快找到默尔索，再想办法离开这里吧……>
 <Let's quickly find Meursault and figure out how to get out of this place...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
那我们……先继续往前走？直走吗？
 Should we... keep movin' for now? Straight ahead?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
经理阁下。我建议先返回洗手间，重新会合并整顿队伍。
 Executive Manager. I recommend returning to the restroom to regroup and reorganize.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
我……赞同罗佳小姐的建议。事不宜迟，吾等即刻出发吧……
 I... assent to Young Rodya's counsel. Let us set forth with all haste, forsooth...
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
<李箱刚才差点受伤，辛克莱应该也需要一点时间平复情绪。>
 <Yi Sang almost got hurt just now. And I think Sinclair needs a moment to collect himself.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<就按奥提斯说的做吧。先回洗手间会合，喘口气再出发。>
 <Let's do as Outis said. Regroup in the restroom, take a breather, then head out.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
谢谢您，经理……
 Thank you, Manager...
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
<color=#916e46>请各位注意。条纹季现已正式结束。我们很高兴地通知各位，千鸟格已成为全新潮流。</color>
 <color=#916e46>Your attention, please. The Stripe Season has officially ended. We are pleased to inform you that Houndstooth is the new trend.</color>

什么？！不！我从大腿上剥了那么多皮，才做出那些条纹……结果全都白费了？！我才刚把横纹一路铺到下巴，他们怎么能现在就换潮流！ What?! No! I flayed so much skin off my thighs to make those stripe patterns... and it was all for nothing?! I only just got the horizontal lines all the way up to my chin. They can't change the trend now!
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
我得把新品陈列区填满！得想个办法，想个办法……要不把现有的东西撕成方格图案？绝不能让它们沦落到清仓区！
 I have to fill the new-arrivals displays! Need a plan, need a plan... Maybe tear what's there into a checkered pattern? I can't let those go to clearance!
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
<……还真是忙得不可开交啊……>
 <... Pretty hectic, huh...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<color=#515aee>让我……暂且触碰你一会儿。</color>
 <color=#515aee>Let me... lay my hands on you awhile.</color>

<color=#515aee>每一段旅程……在启程之前……都需要些许触碰。</color>
 <color=#515aee>Every voyage... requires some touch... before it begins.</color>

<默尔索！原来我看到的就是这里……你在这里做什么？>
 <Meursault! So this is the place I saw... What are you doing here?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……我进入百货商店，继续前行，抵达了这家店铺。
 ... I entered the Grand Magasin, proceeded onward, and arrived at this shop.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
搞什么嘛，默尔！看到我们，你至少也装得惊讶一点吧。我们可是来救你的！
 What the heck, Meur! Ya could at least pretend to be surprised to see us. We came to save ya!
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
据我所知，以常规手段无法进入西西弗。
 As far as I'm aware, entry to Sisyphe is beyond ordinary means.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
如果你们并非因西西弗惩罚而被带到这里，那就必然是通过了另一条未知路径。
 If you were not brought here via the Sisyphe Penalty, then you must have taken another, unknown route.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<……没错，是赫尔曼和她的手下帮了我们。>
 <... That's right. Hermann and her lackeys helped us.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
原来如此。
 I see.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
先别管那个。默尔索，你这段时间到底一直在这里做什么？
 Forget about that. Just what have you been doing here all this time, Meursault?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
还有，这里究竟是什么地方？
 And what is this place?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
我……目前正在被储存。
 I am... currently in storage.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
你这到底是什——
 What does that even—
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
*叹气* 就算到了这里，你还是和在外面时一样不愿解释自己。
 *sigh* Just as averse to explaining yourself as you were outside, even in this place.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
你们是什么人？
 Who are you people?
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
退后。这份材料是我先发现的，先到先得。现在他属于我们店了。
 Back off. I found this material first. Finders keepers. It belongs to our store now.
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
“材料”……？呃……听我说，这家伙是我们的……嗯，“同事”。可以把他还给我们吗？
 "Material"...? Um... Look, this dude is our... uh, "colleague." Can we have him back, please?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
“同事”……嗯，我以前听过这个词。是某个品牌名吗？
 "Colleague"... Hm. I've heard that word before. Is it a brand name?
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
从目前在这里看到的情况来说……我不知道常识在这里到底靠不靠得住。
 From what we've seen of this place so far... I don't know if common sense is all that reliable in here.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
你说他属于你们店……是打算让他在这里工作吗？
 When you said he belongs to your store... does that mean you're gonna put him to work?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
不是。这家店的人手已经绰绰有余，短缺的是材料。
 No. We have more than enough staff for this shop. It's the material that's in shortage.
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
材料……？哦，明白了。你是想，呃……借走默尔索的制服……？
 Material...? Oh, okay. I suppose you wanna, uh... borrow Meursault's uniform, then...?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
你们这些陌生人根本无法沟通。我真是束手无策了……
 You strangers are impossible to communicate with. I'm at my wits' end here...
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
店员用无可奈何的眼神看着我们。
 The employee gave us an exasperated look.
我说的是我们缺少材料。材料。这有什么难懂的？ I said we're in a shortage of material. Material. What's so hard to understand about that?
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
你们没听见刚才的广播吗？潮流又变了。再过几个季度，还会有别的东西成为新潮流。所以我们——还有这家店——永远都需要更多材料！
 Didn't you hear the announcement just now? The trend has changed again. A few seasons from now, there will be another thing that becomes the new trend. That's why we—and this shop—will always be in need of more material!
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text: 我明白，我明白，但这跟—— I get that, I get that, but what the hell does that have to do with—
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
你们这些陌生人里有没有比这家伙更懂常识的？我说的话她一个字都听不懂！
 Do any of you strangers have more common sense than this one? This one doesn't get a single word I'm saying!
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
明明是你——
 You're the one who—
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
我觉得吧，玛莉……这些人不会就这么把默尔交给我们。我们得和他们谈个条件。
 I think, Ishy... these people aren't about to hand Meur over just like that. We'll need to make a deal with them.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
话是这么说，但谈条件得双方能沟通才行啊……
 Sure, but a deal needs two-way communication, you know...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
我明白你的意思，玛莉。玛莉？
 I get whatcha mean, Ishy. Ishy?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
我只是觉得，再问下去恐怕不是让事情继续推进的最好办法。
 I'm just sayin', I don't think asking more questions is our best shot at moving on.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
好吧。那你就直说吧，要我们拿什么来换这份，呃，“材料”？
 All right. Why don'tcha go ahead and tell me what you want in return for this, uh, "material"?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text: 这才算说到点子上。好吧，你们想要什么？ Now we're getting somewhere. All right, what do you want?
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
失去这么有潜力的材料实在可惜……怎么办，怎么办……
 It's a shame to lose such promising material... What to do, what to do...
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
……那好吧。你们可以干活抵偿这份材料的价值，这样就算两清。就当是来打零工吧。为了跟上最新潮流，我们光是更换陈列和订货单就已经忙得不可开交了。
 ... All right, then. You can work off the material's value, and I'm willing to call it even. Consider it a part-time job. We're really swamped as it is, changing up the displays and order sheets to keep pace with the latest trends.
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
可、可以……要我们跑什么腿？
 S-sure... What kind of errand?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
附近有片区域，到处都是人偶。
 There's an area nearby full of Mannequins.
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
……人偶？
 ... Mannequins?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
以实玛利忍不住再次插话，但罗佳连忙朝她投去恳求的眼神，她很快便放弃了。
 Unable to restrain herself, Ishmael cut in once more, but quickly gave up when Rodion hurriedly sent a desperate look her way.

问题是，那些人偶身上穿的衣服早就远远落后于当下潮流了。
 The problem is that those Mannequins are dressed in clothes that have fallen way, way behind the current fashion trend.
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
要是来这里购物的顾客看到那些无可救药的过时人偶，不肯进我们店怎么办？
 What if customers coming here to shop see those hopelessly dated Mannequins and refuse to enter our store?
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
对、对哦……那对店里来说确实是个大问题吧……嗯……完全没错……
 R-right... That would be a real problem for the shop, wouldn't it...? Yeah... totally...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
罗佳用力点着头，似乎过分努力地想对店员的困境表示同情。
 Rodya nodded vigorously, perhaps trying a little too hard to look sympathetic to the employee's plight.

没错。所以，我要你们帮助那些人偶前往出口。
 Yes. Which means I want you to help the Mannequins to the exit.
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
“帮助它们前往出口”？好吧，现在连我也糊涂了。我们到底该做什么？
 "Help them to the exit"? Okay, now I'm confused, too. Just what are we supposed to do?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
要求很简单。
 The request is simple.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
我们需要消灭他们称为“人偶”的实体。
 We are to eliminate the entities they call "Mannequins."
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
你的意思是杀了它们？
 You mean kill them?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
你问的问题比平时更多。
 You are asking more questions than usual.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
不然呢？这里的人说的话，我有一半都听不明白。
 What do you expect? I can't understand half of what anyone here says.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
原来如此。
 I see.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text: 你明白什么了？ You see what?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
我意识到，从你的视角来看，这里的事物或许难以理解。
 I have realized that things here might appear inscrutable from your perspective.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
你应该明白，在这里，“常识”一词的含义或许与通常用法不同。
 You should understand that, in this place, the word "common sense" may be received differently from its conventional usage.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
所以呢？你们到底帮不帮助那些人偶前往出口？
 Well? Are you helping those Mannequins to the exit or not?
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
稍等一下嘛～哈哈……我们只是想先看看你们店里的东西……这些衣服真、真是不同凡响！
 Give us a sec~ Haha... We're just taking a quick look around your shop... These clothes are o-out of this world!
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
哦，好啊！买下这个，我就把那套衣服也送给你。现在正值季末特卖。
 Oh, okay! Buy this, and I'll throw in that outfit as well. We're holding an end-of-season sale.
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
所以到底怎么决定？要救默尔索，就得杀掉这个人所说的那些人偶——是这样吗？
 So what's it gonna be? If we wanna save Meursault, we kill the things this person calls Mannequins—is that correct?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
正确。
 Correct.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
你们还没逛够吗？看了这么久却什么都不买，不觉得说不过去吗？
 Haven't you been browsing long enough? Don't you think you ought to buy something after that much window-shopping?
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
<总之……先去人偶所在的地方吧。>
 <For now... let's head to where the Mannequins are.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
好吧……我们会帮助它们前往出口。
 Okay, then... we'll help them to the exit.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
明智的选择。你们只需要帮助三具人偶前往出口。
 Good choice. You only need to help three Mannequins to the exit.
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
<我们会回来的，所以你先继续被储存——我是说，在这里等我们吧，默尔索。>
 <We'll be back, so stay in storage—I mean, wait for us here, Meursault.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……我必须与您同行，经理。
 ... I must accompany you, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<为什么？>
 <What for?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
哎呀～你是觉得我们没本事完成任务，对吧？
 Aw~ You're thinkin' we're not up to the task, aren'tcha?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
有一个问题，经理。你们在前往这个房间的途中，很可能遇到了他们所称的“人偶”。你是否尝试过与它们进行肢体接触？
 A question, Manager. It is likely that you have encountered entities they refer to as "Mannequins" on your way to this room. Did you try making physical contact with them?
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<呃……我不太确定怎样才算“人偶”，不过暂时还没试过碰它们。其实有些似乎根本察觉不到我……>
 <Uh... I'm not sure exactly what counts as a "Mannequin," but I haven't tried touching any of them just yet. Some didn't seem to perceive me at all, actually...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
正是如此。接触本就不可能。大概只有我能直接干涉存在于此处的实体。
 Indeed. Contact would have been impossible. I am likely the only person capable of direct intervention with the entities that exist in here.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
不过，只要在我身后排成一列，就能在有限程度上与环境互动，尽管还不足以同这些实体交战。
 However, standing behind me in a line will allow for a limited degree of interactivity with the environment, though it will not be sufficient to engage these entities in battle.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<咦，这是为什么……？>
 <Huh. And why is that...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
因为此处属于象征界，经理。
 Because this place belongs to the Symbolic, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
你的意思是……我们没办法参与这里发生的任何战斗？
 Are ya sayin'... we cannot participate in any battles that take place in here?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
在暗影界便可以。
 It will be possible in the Shadowed.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
象征界、暗影界……那是什么？
 Symbolic, Shadowed... What are those?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
这是构成这座百货商店的各个世界的名称。
 They are names for the constituent worlds of this department store.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
呃……这算不上什么解释吧。
 Uh... That's not much of an answer, is it.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
若要作出比这更详尽的解释，便需要投入大量时间。
 A more thorough explanation than this would require a significant time investment.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<……不管怎样，想真正推进下去，我们确实需要默尔索同行，对吧？>
 <... Either way, we do need Meursault with us if we're going to make any real progress, right?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
正是如此，经理。
 That is correct, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<那就由你带头吧，默尔索。>
 <Then you should take the lead, Meursault.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<我会告诉你该往哪边走。>
 <I'll tell you which way to go.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我会照办。
 It will be done.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
他们需要我同行，才能完成你交给我们的工作。我可以暂时离开一会儿吗？
 They need me to accompany them in order to fulfill the work you assigned to us. May I step away for a short while?
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
嗯，可以。
 Yeah, sure.
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
<……等等，现在默尔索已经跟我们会合了。要不我们直接溜走，再也不回来？>
 <... Wait, we have Meursault now. What if we just split and never came back?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
逃跑并不能阻止我被重新储存，经理。
 Fleeing would not prevent me from being placed in storage, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
好吧……所以带着你逃跑会给我们惹麻烦，对吧？
 Okay... so you're saying runnin' away with you would cause trouble for us, right?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
正确。
 Correct.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
也许这里就像大湖一样，有属于自己的法则。
 Maybe this place has its own Laws—just like the Great Lake.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
*叹气* 就按默尔索说的做吧。虽然不知道原因和经过，但他似乎对这座百货商店相当熟悉。
 *sigh* Let's do as Meursault says. I don't know why or how, but he seems to be well-acquainted with the department store.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<好。就这么办吧。>
 <Right. Sounds like a plan.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我可没时间等上一整天。快点作出决定。
 Can't wait around all day. Hurry up and make up your mind.
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
怎么样？考虑好了吗？
 Well? Have you given it some thought?
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
经理，如果您需要我效力，最好满足那名店员的需求。
 Giving the clerk what they need is probably best if you require my service, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
既然已经接下工作……就快点，好吗？这个季度随时都可能结束……
 Since you're already on the job... hurry up, will you? This season could end any minute...
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
所以这就是……“人偶”？
 So this is... a "Mannequin?"
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
不管是这东西，还是我们之前看到的……都很像我们所说的扭曲。你怎么看，但丁？
 Both this thing and what we saw earlier... they feel a lot like the things we call Distortions. What do you think, Dante?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
<确实很像……我觉得它们真的就是扭曲。>
 <They do... I think they really are Distortions.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
不会吧……潮流又变了？
 No way... The trend changed again?
texts.speaker:
皮革手套
 Leather Glove

texts.text:
现在流行什么？我没听见广播。
 What's in fashion now? I didn't hear the announcement.
texts.speaker:
皮革手套
 Leather Glove

texts.text:
更重要的是，你们怎么能穿着这么难看的衣服到处走？难道一点都不觉得羞耻吗？那绝不可能是当下潮流！
 More importantly, how can you be walking around in hideous clothes like those? Aren't you even ashamed of yourselves? That couldn't possibly be the current trend!
texts.speaker:
皮革手套
 Leather Glove

texts.text:
条纹总有一天会重新流行！时尚永远都会轮回来！
 Stripes will return one day! Fashion always comes back around!
texts.speaker:
皮革手套
 Leather Glove

texts.text: 呃啊……你们穿着如此令人作呕的破布……竟然说我过时……？ Kergh... You dress in such repulsive rags... yet you call me outdated...?
texts.speaker:
皮革手套
 Leather Glove

texts.text:
下次……我一定能成功。我一定会……登上T台……
 Next time... I'll make it. I'll be the one... to make it to the runway...
texts.speaker:
皮革手套
 Leather Glove

texts.text:
看来你们成功帮助它们前往出口了。多亏你们，现在能来我们店里的顾客更多了。
 So you managed to help them to the exit. Thanks to you, more customers can now access our shop.
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
呼……我们眼下真是忙得不可开交。潮流变了，整套产品都得重新设计、全面翻新。
 Whew... We've got so much on our plates at the moment. We need to redesign and revamp the entire lineup, what with the trend changing.
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
虽然被迫放弃这份材料很可惜，但也只能这样了……
 Shame we're forced to part with this material, but that's that...
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
<color=#916e46>请各位注意。千鸟格季现已正式结束。我们很高兴地通知各位……</color>
 <color=#916e46>Your attention, please. The Houndstooth Season has officially ended. We are pleased to inform you that...</color>

真是的！和你们闲聊浪费时间的时候，潮流居然又变了。不买东西就赶紧滚！
 Good grief! The trend changed again while I was wasting time shooting the breeze with you. Scram if you're not buying anything!
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
所以……你没哪里受伤吧，默尔？
 So... you're not hurt anywhere, are you, Meur?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
自我进入西西弗以来，未曾发生暴力冲突。我没有受伤。
 There have been no violent altercations since I entered Sisyphe. I have sustained no injuries.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
他们一开始为什么要抓你？
 Why did they seize you in the first place?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
他们认为我属于卡基。
 They believed I belonged to Le Kaki.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<卡基？那是什么？>
 <Le Kaki? What's that?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
到处都是疑问和困惑——这也情有可原，因为默尔索丝毫没有主动解释的打算，就连那些我们自以为熟悉的词语，对此处的实体而言也有着截然不同的含义。
 Questions and doubts everywhere—understandable, because Meursault showed no intention of explaining matters proactively, and even the words we thought we knew held completely different meanings to the entities in this place.

百货商店的顾客可分为四个主要群体，经理。
 The customers of the department store can be classified into four principal groups, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
主流群体被称为漆黑者与赤红者。不属于任何一方的人则被称为卡基。最后，还有那些从不现身，也从不被他人提及的人。
 The mainstream groups are called Le Noir and Le Rouge. Those belonging to neither are known as Le Kaki. Lastly, there are those who never reveal themselves, nor are they called upon by others.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
这些……“卡基”……经常会像这样被绑架吗？
 Do these... "Kaki" people... often get kidnapped like that?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
将我的遭遇称为“绑架”并不准确。卡基的存在取决于潮流的流向；因此，他们有时会被当作工具，或是制作服装的材料。
 It is inaccurate to label what happened to me as "kidnapping." The Kakis' existence is defined by the current's flow; therefore, they are sometimes used as tools or as materials for clothing production.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
大多数卡基都以购买并穿上心仪的服装为目标。我没有这种目标，因此他们得以将我当作材料使用。
 Most Kakis aim to purchase and wear the garments they desire. I possessed no such objective, which made it possible for them to use me as material.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
我还是没弄明白全貌……所以在这里必须得有个与时尚有关的目的？比如……买衣服、试穿什么的？
 I still don't get the full picture... So you need to have a fashion purpose here? Like... buying clothes, trying 'em on and stuff?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
这里的人……除了衣服以外，似乎对什么都不感兴趣。
 The people here... seemed interested in nothing but clothes.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
与其说是目的，不如说是存在理由。
 It is less a purpose than a raison d'être.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
每个答案都会催生出更多疑问，我只得插话，问出那个总得有人提出的根本问题。
 With every answer breeding more questions, I had no choice but to cut in and ask the one fundamental subject someone had to ask.

<那么，既然这些都说清楚了，默尔索，你能告诉我们……>
 <So, now that all's said and done, Meursault, could you tell us...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<我们究竟身处何处吗？>
 <Where exactly we are?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
西西弗……
 Sisyphe...
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<对，我知道我们在西西弗百货，也知道这里是百货商店。但我想问的是……>
 <Yes, I know we're in Grand Magasin Sisyphe, and yes, it's a department store. But what I'm asking is...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<这栋建筑位于N公司的什么地方？这里的这些人又都在做什么？>
 <Where in N Corp. is this building located? And what are all these people doing in here?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我们要怎样才能离开这里？
 What can we do to get out of this place?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
问题接连不断地砸来，默尔索却始终注视着我，连眉毛都没有动一下。
 The barrage of questions were unrelenting, but Meursault kept his gaze trained on me without moving so much as an eyebrow.

问题不止一个，我会逐项回答。
 There are more than a few questions, so I will address them individually.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
第一点：这里并非以实体形式建造的建筑，经理。
 Point one: This is not a physically constructed building, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<不是实体建筑……？>
 <Not physically constructed...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我的身体目前正失去意识，躺在N公司某处西西弗塔内的一只大缸中。
 My body currently lies unconscious inside a vat at the Sisyphe Tower, somewhere within N Corp.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
你和其他罪人的十二具身体，很可能就在你们使用的多人自杀贩卖机内部。
 The 12 bodies belonging to you and the other Sinners are likely inside the group Suicide Vending Machine you used.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
那么……我们的意识被转移到了这里……
 Then... our minds have been moved here...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
而这里是由西西弗刑罚受刑者的意识所栖居的虚拟空间？
 And this is a virtual space inhabited by the minds of those sentenced to Sisyphe Penalty?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
正确。
 Correct.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
原来如此。所以他们才把那种令人不适的体验设计成通往这里的入口……
 I see. So that's why they made that disturbing experience an entry passage leading here...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
继续下一点，经理。
 Moving on, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
第二点：进入西西弗百货的每个人都会被认定为“顾客”，并从事两种行为之一——生产服装，或消费服装。
 Point two: Every person who enters the Grand Magasin Sisyphe is designated a "customer" who will do one of two things—manufacture clothing, or consume it.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
那我们之前看到的所有东西，应该也都算服装，对吧？
 Then I suppose everything we saw earlier counts as clothing too, right?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
正确。
 Correct.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
但我以为这里应该是经验罐头工厂。把人们的意识囚禁在虚拟空间里，让他们制造服装而不是罐头——我是说，为什么要做这些？
 But I thought this place was supposed to be a Canned Experience factory. Imprisoning people's minds in a virtual space, making them manufacture clothing instead of cans—I mean, why do any of that?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
那是……一个很难回答的问题。
 That is... not a question easily answered.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
人类为何存在、又如何存在的问题，不容许人们探寻出终极答案；而且，提出这个问题本身也是徒劳。
 The question of how and why human beings exist does not admit any attempt at discovering an ultimate answer and, moreover, is a futile one to ask.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
西西弗百货的顾客为何渴望购买并穿上服装，以及这座百货商店为何、又是通过何种过程诞生……同样是无法参透的问题。
 The questions of why the customers of Grand Magasin Sisyphe seek to purchase and wear clothing, and of why and through what process the department store came into existence... are likewise unfathomable subjects.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
等等，为什么突然谈起存在主义了？我只是想问服装和罐头之间有什么关系……
 Sorry, why are we suddenly getting all existential? I was just asking what clothes and cans have to do with each other...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
两者都无法回答，却又为人类认知所接受，因此这种并置是恰当的。
 It is an apt juxtaposition insofar as both are unanswerable, yet accepted by human perception.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
你到底在说什——
 What are you even—
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
好了，够了。我可不想围着这些毫无意义的胡话继续绕圈子。再说下去，我也要像这里其他疯子一样发疯了。
 All right, that's enough. I don't wanna keep going in circles over pointless gibberish. Any more of this and I'm gonna go crazy like the other wackos in here.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
所以，总结一下：这里看起来很真实，但其实是个只有我们的意识存在的虚拟空间——就像缸中之脑。我们的身体都在那台自杀贩卖机里舒舒服服地开睡衣派对。这里的居民全是疯子。好了，全都解释清楚了。
 So, let's summarize: this place looks real, but it's a virtual space where only our minds exist—like brains in a vat. Our bodies are all slumber partyin' nice and cozy inside that Suicide Vending Machine. The residents here are all nutjobs. Done. All cleared up.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
这样一来，计划就很简单：救出默尔——已经救了；确认他安然无恙——确实没事；顺走屋顶上的金枝，然后离开这里。大家都同意吧？
 With that, our plan is simple: rescue Meur—we did that—find him in one piece—he is—yoink the Golden Bough on the rooftop, and get ourselves outta here. Everyone agree?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
像这样把一切都梳理清楚后，事情似乎简单多了……
 Laying it all out like that seemed to make things much simpler...

……然而，一路走来经历过足够多的磨难后，我们再清楚不过，这件事说起来容易，做起来却很难。
 ... and yet, having experienced enough ordeals throughout our journey, we knew all too well that it was easier said than done.

第三点：
 Point three:
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<拜托，别再说了……>
 <Please, no...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
目前，任何进入西西弗百货的人……
 There is no method by which an individual who enters Sisyphe...
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……都无法离开并回到外界。
 ... may leave and return to the outside world at present.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
默尔索毫不迟疑地说出了这句灾难性的判决，每一个沉重的字眼都斩钉截铁。
 Meursault delivered every grave word of the catastrophic verdict without a moment's hesitation.

<……就没有什么办法可以试试吗？比如某处松动的后门……？或是在这里打倒一个守卫再离开……？>
 <... Nothing we can even try? A loose Backdoor somewhere...? Maybe defeat a guard in here and leave...?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
尽管此处呈现出建筑物的特征，但这里是一个象征性空间，经理。
 Although it assumes the characteristics of a building, this is a symbolic space, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
这里并不存在通常意义上的入口或出口。
 It has no entrance or exit in the conventional sense.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
因此，即便我们穿过某条看似通往“出口”的通道，也只是一种“象征性”的行为——并不会让我们真正离开。
 Accordingly, even if we were to cross through some apparent passage leading to an "exit," it would only be a "representative" act—without resulting in our actual departure.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
你这么平静地说出这种糟糕透顶的结论，反而让人感觉更难受了……
 Y'know, it makes it even worse when ya say that awful conclusion so matter-of-factly...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
我并非以平静的口吻陈述。我只是在陈述事实。
 I did not speak matter-of-factly. I spoke the matter of fact.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<也就是说……我们根本没有任何办法能离开这里？>
 <Does that mean... there's no way out whatsoever for us?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
但丁，你能别这么乌鸦嘴吗……？
 Dante, can you not jinx us like that...?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
经理，你和其他人是以非常规手段进入此处的。因此，你们或许存在离开的途径。
 You and the others entered this place by means that cannot be described as conventional, Manager. An exit may exist in your case.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
然而，这种可能性并不能保证我也能被带离此处。
 However, that possibility does not guarantee that I can be removed from this place.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
听起来……你好像以前来过这里，默尔。是吗？
 Ya sound like... you've been here before, Meur. Have you?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
此处专门用于关押被判处西西弗刑的罪犯。没有违反N公司的法律的居民，无法通过正常手段抵达这里。
 This place is reserved for criminals sentenced to the Sisyphe Penalty. Residents who have not violated N Corp.'s laws cannot arrive here through ordinary means.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
那你为什么会知道这么多？
 Then how do you know so much about it?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
……我在N公司任职期间获取了这些信息。
 ... I acquired the information while working for N Corp.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
很难想象默尔索手捧一只杯子，与其他人闲聊的模样。
 It was difficult to imagine Meursault in an idle conversation with other people, with a cup in his hands.

但如果进来的人永远无法离开，又怎么可能有人告诉你——*叹气*算了。罗佳说得对。我们又开始绕圈子了。
 But if nobody who enters can ever leave, how could anyone have told you—*sigh* never mind. Rodya's right. We're talking in circles now.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
总之，到头来我们还是得取回金枝，对吧？即便我们找不到“正常”的出口。
 Anyway, it all comes down to us having to retrieve the Golden Bough, right? Even though there's no "proper" exit we can find.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
那么……看来我们唯一的选择就是向上攀登。我们能找到航行穿越大湖的方法，也一定能找到在这里前进的方法。
 Then... I suppose our only option is to climb toward the top. We found a way to sail through the Great Lake—we will find a way to navigate this place as well.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
我一度考虑过，要不要指出那艘船本来就配有用来确认位置的坐标追踪器，但最后还是识趣地闭上了嘴。面无表情地陈述事实并不总能帮上忙。
 I considered for a moment whether it would be wise to point out that the ship had come equipped with a coordinates tracker to tell us where we were, but decided to bite my proverbial tongue. Deadpan truths are not always helpful.

无论这里是否为虚拟空间，作为团队的经理，我能说的始终只有一句话。
 Virtual or not, as the Manager of the team, there was only one thing I could ever say.

<那就继续前进吧。这里应该有楼梯，或是其他能让我们前往下一层的东西。>
 <Then let's keep moving. There should be stairs or something else that can take us to the next floor.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
哦！你看起来也是刚到这里，对吧？
 Oh! You look like you've just got here, too! Right?

谢天谢地。我被判处西西弗刑后就送到了这里，可根本没人愿意给我解释！一提起这里，所有人就只会说些谜语和胡话——我是说，就连外面的人也一样。至于这里的人？他们甚至会发火，还抱怨我连常识都没有！ Thank goodness. I got sent here after being sentenced to the Sisyphe Penalty, but nobody would explain anything to me! All anyone says are riddles and nonsense when it comes to this place—and I mean people outside as well. The ones here? They even get angry and complain about me not having common sense!

而且你猜怎么着，甚至还有人问能不能拿我当材料。这大概是他们在这里使用的某种行话吧。
 And guess what, one person even asked if they could use me as material. Must be some kind of jargon they use in here.

所以……你是什么时候到这里的？
 So... when didya get here?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
我也正想弄清楚呢。这里没有时钟，而且他们计算日子的方式也很奇怪。哦！说到时钟——你的脑袋就是一个！你能告诉我现在几点了吗？我很确定自己已经很久没吃东西了，可不知为什么，我一点都不饿……
 That's exactly what I'm trying to figure out. There are no clocks here, and they have this weird way of counting days. Oh! Speaking of clocks—you've got one for a head! Could you tell me what time it is now? I know for sure it's been ages since my last meal, but somehow I don't feel hungry...

<没错，这就是刚从外界来到这里的人会有的反应。>
 <Yup, that's the reaction of someone who just came from the outside world.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
哇，那些是制服吗？你们以前肯定属于一个相当厉害的帮派。你们到底做了什么，才会让他们决定把所有人打包扔进这里？
 Whoa, are those uniforms? You must've belonged to a pretty serious Syndicate. Just what did you do that they decided to throw everyone in here as a package?

嗯，该怎么说呢……他们指控我们“对某位同事关心得稍微过头了”，这样说你能明白吗？
 Hm, how should I put this... They charged us with "caring a lil' too much about a certain colleague of ours", if that makes sense?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
那你呢……？你做了什么才会被判处这种刑罚？
 And you...? What did you do to receive the Penalty?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
我和朋友们一起捣鼓出了一种产品。
 There's this product my friends and I cooked up.

……我猜，这种“产品”在N公司属于违法制造品。
 ... I assume this "product" was illegal to manufacture in N Corp.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
哇。你怎么猜到的？
 Whoa. How did you guess?

……我是说，这不是很明显吗？不然他们为什么会判你西西弗刑？
 ... I mean, it's obvious. Why else would they give you the Sisyphe Penalty?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
哇。你的口气跟审判我的那个检察官一模一样！
 Wow. You sound exactly like that prosecutor at my trial!

审判一开始，法庭里的所有人就把我狠狠训斥了一顿。他们说什么，我散布那种产品，在N公司的居民中制造了混乱与不安……
 Everyone in the courtroom reprimanded me so hard once my trial began. They said something about how I was sowing confusion and unrest among the residents of N Corp. by distributing products like that...

你们到底做了什么？
 What exactly did you make?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
假冒经验罐头。哦，对了，标签是我设计的——我从小就很有艺术天分。内容物由劳拉负责。做起来很简单，只需要面粉、粉笔灰，再加一撮奶粉。真正需要小心的是原料的配比。
 Counterfeit Canned Experience. Oh, I'm the one who designed the label, by the way—I've been quite an artist since I was little. Laura was in charge of the contents. It's easy stuff. All you need is some flour, chalk dust, and a pinch of powdered milk. The ratio of the ingredients is where you need to be careful.

假冒经验罐头……？还有这种东西？
 Counterfeit Canned Experience...? That's a thing?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text: 啊？为什么没有？我是说，只要让它看起来一样就行。相信我，后巷里靠制造假冒经验罐头谋生的人多得是。毕竟，只要贴着“经验”的标签，人们就怎么也买不够。 Huh? Why wouldn't it be? I mean, you only need to make it look the same. Believe me, there are plenty of people in the Backstreets who make a living by making fake Canned Experiences. People can't get enough of anything labeled "experience," after all.

总之，这是我第一次体验西西弗刑。要是能交保释金，也许他们会早点放我出去。伯纳德说他会试着靠卖假罐头凑钱。
 Anyway, this is the first time I've experienced the Sisyphe Penalty. Maybe they'll let me out sooner if I can post bail. Bernard said he'd try to raise the money from selling the fake cans.

这样啊……那你的脸是怎么回事……？他们伤害过你吗？
 Right... And what happened to your face...? Did they hurt you or something?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
哦，这是我小时候住的孤儿院失火时留下的。那时我只是个流浪儿，没能及时接受妥善治疗，所以就……这样了。伯纳德更惨——他落下了永久的跛脚。劳拉的情况还要糟。吸入的烟气严重损伤了她的肺，所以她没法长时间奔跑。带着这种伤疤，就别想在巢里工作了，对吧？
 Oh, I got this from a fire that broke out in the orphanage I grew up in. I couldn't get proper treatment in time what with being an urchin and all, and... well. Bernard has it worse—he's left with a permanent limp. Even worse for Laura. Breathing in smoke really messed up her lungs, so she can't run for too long. Say goodbye to ever working in a Nest with scars like these, right?

不过嘛，至少这座监狱还挺气派的。我还从没见过或听说过哪座监狱不把人锁进牢房，反而让囚犯到处走动。
 But hey, at least this prison's pretty snazzy. And I've never seen or heard of a prison where they let you wander around without locking you up in a cell.

对了，我叫杜博阿。大家也叫我“疤脸D”。
 The name's Dubois, by the way. People also call me "Scar D."
texts.speaker:
杜博阿
 Dubois

texts.text:
这个人……
 This guy...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
他完全不知道发生了什么。就像不久前的我们一样……
 He has no idea what is happening. Just like us a little while ago...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
不知道为什么，我……有点同情他……
 I don't know, I... kinda feel bad for him...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
而且，呃……他还有点神经质，总是从一个话题突然跳到另一个话题。
 And, uh... he's kinda neurotic, too, jumping from one subject to the other.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
话说回来……如果这里是监狱，那守卫都在哪里……？监狱里不该有典狱长之类的人吗？
 By the way... If this is a prison, where are the guards...? Shouldn't jails have wardens or something?
texts.speaker:
杜博阿
 Dubois

texts.text:
谁知道呢……
 Who knows...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
哦，还有……你们知道怎么上楼吗？上面的楼层说不定有电话亭之类的东西。我得给朋友们打个电话。
 Oh, and... Do you happen to know how to get upstairs? There might be a phone booth or something up there on the upper floors. I need to call my friends.
texts.speaker:
杜博阿
 Dubois

texts.text:
我们也在找上楼的路。
 We're looking for a way up too.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
哦，这样啊……好吧。如果我找到了，会告诉你们的。
 Oh, I see... Okay. I'll let you know if I manage to find one.
texts.speaker:
杜博阿
 Dubois

texts.text:
我会留意有没有通往上面的楼梯或电梯！
 I'll be keeping an eye out for any staircases or elevators leading up!
texts.speaker:
杜博阿
 Dubois

texts.text: [미사용] 이제 퀘스트는 없어
texts.speaker:
新手1 NPC
 뉴비1 npc

texts.text:
这里的店员似乎不怎么愿意招呼我们。
 This employee here isn't so eager to greet us.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<这……正常吗？>
 <Is that... normal?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
漆黑者店铺的售货员并无义务主动与顾客建立供需关系。
 Vendors of Le Noir establishments are not compelled to initiate provider-client engagement.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
好吧，那我们就别打扰他，继续走？这不是两全其美嘛。
 Welp, then let's not bother 'em and move on? Sounds like a win-win.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
我们几乎能感觉到他戒备的目光刺在皮肤上。既然他并不打算阻止我们浏览商品，为什么还要像鹰一样盯着我们……？
 We can almost feel his guarded stare against our skin. If he's not about to stop us from browsing, why is he watching us like a hawk...?

它看起来有些像西装……只是剪裁设计要高雅得多。
 It looks something like a suit... only cut from a far more classy design.

咦。其实比我想象中好看多了。真时髦！
 Huh. That's actually a lot nicer than I expected. So chic!
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
……我们再看看别的吧。
 ... Let's look around some more.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
哦，你不觉得这件就是为但丁量身打造的吗？
 Ooh, don'tcha think this one's made for Dante?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
<真、真的吗？>
 <Y-you think so?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
当然啦！这套衣服简直在求你把它穿走。我们不是有之前拿到的那些眼球嘛——干吗不犒劳一下自己？
 Ya bet! That fit is practically beggin' for ya. And we've got those eyeballs from earlier—why not treat yourself?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
等等。这是附近唯一接受的货币。我们应该先分清轻重缓急，再像这样大手大脚地——
 Hang on. It's the only kind of currency they'll accept around here. We should set our priorities right before we splash cash like—
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<别担心，以实玛利。反正我们也买不起。>
 <Don't worry, Ishmael. We can't afford it anyway.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
买不起？
 We can't?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
咿……450颗眼球？这也太坑人了！
 Eeep... 450 eyeballs? What a ripoff!
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
也可能只是我们太穷了。
 Or maybe we're just too broke.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<和休闲装馆不同，这里的所有东西看起来都是同一种风格。>
 <Unlike the Casualwear Hall, everything here has the same sort of look.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
这些服装并不迎合转瞬即逝的潮流。
 These garments do not submit to passing trends.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
漆黑者与赤红者旗下的当代派品牌，均依照各自派系的审美教义，使所售系列刻意维持统一的视觉风格。
 The collections sold by Contemporary labels of Le Noir and Le Rouge each maintain a deliberate visual consistency, according to the aesthetic doctrine of their respective factions.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<但如果他们一直制作同一类服装……不会被时尚抛在后面吗？这里的潮流每5分钟就会变一次。>
 <But if they keep making the same kinds of clothes... won't fashion leave them behind? Trends change every 5 minutes in this place.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
那是——
 That is—
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
当设计师的名号足够响亮时，就用不着追逐潮流。反而是潮流会追着你跑。
 When a designer's name carries enough weight, ya don't chase trends. Trends chase ya instead.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
这么精致的东西，只要贴上名牌，再标个离谱的价格，你还什么都没做呢，人们就会排起长队。
 Slap a famous label and a ridiculous price on something this fancy, and people will line up before ya lift a finger.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
根本不用为了追上每一个小潮流……把自己累得够呛。
 No need to run yourself ragged.. to keep up with every little craze.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
整套服装都整齐地呈现在眼前。
 The entire outfit fits neatly into view.

<这么一想，这家百货商店里陈列的几乎全是服装。不知道他们的生产线是什么样的。>
 <Come to think of it, almost everything on display in this department store is clothing. Wonder what their production line looks like.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
经理，西西弗百货提供了各种机会，可供获取形形色色的材料与配件。
 Grand Magasin Sisyphe offers various opportunities to procure a sundry of material and attachments, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
嗯……在外面的话，材料一般是从驯养的动物或栽培的植物身上获取的吧……
 Well... Outside, I think they get the mats from domesticated animals or plants...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
或者用合成纤维来纺织。
 That, or use synthetic fiber for weaving.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
尽管这里给各种材料所贴的标签与外界不同，
 Though the label upon each material differ from those of the outside,
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
基本的制造原理却并无差别：屠宰原料来源，再使用所得原料进行生产。
 the basic manufacturing principles remain the same: butcher the source and use the raw material for production.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
所谓的“原料”是指……？
 The "raw material" being...?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
顾客。这意味着他们会购买并穿着服装，也可能亲自成为服装。
 Being the clientele. This means they purchase and wear clothing, but may also become clothing themselves.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
这样啊……那西西弗百货的“顾客群”有多大？我是说，被困在这里的顾客？
 Right... So how big is Sisyphe's "clientele"? The customers trapped in this place?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
约三亿人。
 Approximately 300 million.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……我肯定是听错了。
 ... Pretty sure I misheard that.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
你没有听错。西西弗刑不存在获释日期，进入者将永久滞留于此。理论上，其人口会呈无限上升趋势。
 You did not. There is no discharge date for the Sisyphe Penalty, and those who enter remain permanently. Its population is theoretically on an infinite upward trend.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<color=#7d7d7d>且听，吾今日再度宣告。愿吾等安息之厅永世长存，蒙受赐福。</color>
 <color=#7d7d7d>Heed ye, for again I proclaim this day. Blessed be the hall of our rest with eternal preservation.</color>

<color=#7d7d7d>可直至今日，丑恶邪佞之徒仍不断从墙中剜取黄金，将鎏金光辉据为己有，而汝等却无所作为。汝等还要宽恕自己的怯懦之心、软弱地接受末日多久？</color>
 <color=#7d7d7d>Yet even today, ye do naught as the hideous and the wicked ceaselessly tear out the Golden from its walls and take its aureate light for themselves. How long will ye forgive your own craven spirits and feebly accept the end of days?</color>

我将遵从您的旨意，主啊。胆敢掠夺黄金树脂的叛道者必将——
 I shall heed your command, Lord. Apostates who dare plunder the Golden Resin shall—
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
我在顾客当中看见了……甘愿沐浴在亵渎所散发的污浊光辉下之人。
 I see among our clientele... those who gladly bask in the tarnished glow of sacrilege.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
他为什么在看我们……？喂，我们只是在安安分分地逛街！
 Why is he looking at us...? Hey, we were just shopping and minding our own business!
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
这名店员是在对经理说话。
 The employee is speaking to the Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<我？什么？为什么？！>
 <Me? What? Why?!>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
赤红者的势力竟企图煽动混乱、亵渎圣域……回答我，你们为何如此放肆，妄图撕毁古老的停战协定？
 That the forces of Le Rouge would seek to foment disorder and profane the sacred domain... Answer, what is this brazen attempt to null the ancient truce?
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
你给我听好了，老兄。我根本不知道这个滑稽的什么“赤红者”是干什么的，明白吗？我们就是些无名小卒，不属于任何势力，也不想惹麻烦！
 You listen here, Buddy. I don't even know what this funny "Rouge" business is, 'kay? We're nobodies, we're not in any forces of whatever, and we don't want any trouble!
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
啊，那么你们自称是卡基？你们竟把那些亵渎神圣的小玩意挂在脸上，在我们的店里招摇过市，还指望我们相信你们？
 Ah, then you claim to be Kakis? You, who strut through our store flaunting those irreverent trinkets on your face? Do you expect us to believe you?
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
要我猜的话……所谓“亵渎神圣的小玩意”，应该是指但丁的时钟指针……？
 If I were to hazard a guess... I'd say the "blasphemous trinkets" are referring to Dante's clock hands...?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<好吧……可这跟我们有什么关系？>
 <Okay... So what's that got to do with us?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
这或许与漆黑者派系的指导信条有关。
 It is likely due to the guiding tenets of the Le Noir faction.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
据我所知，他们将使这座百货商店永世长存视为自身肩负的使命。
 I was informed that they consider the eternal preservation of this department store to be their appointed mission.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<color=#7d7d7d>汝不可容忍剜取黄金之徒。
汝当涤清吾等疆域中的叛道者。</color>
 <color=#7d7d7d>Thou shalt not suffer those who would scrape out the Golden.
Thou shalt cleanse our domain of apostasy.</color>

我绝不会对他们施以仁慈……我要亲手夺回那璀璨的树脂，支撑起这座圣所日渐黯淡的光芒……是的——我听见了您的声音。身为漆黑者意志的执行之手，我将在此坚守，并且……！
 I shall grant them no mercy... I shall reclaim that radiant resin with my own hands and shore up the fading light of this sanctuary... Yes—your voice reaches me. As the hand of the will that is Le Noir, I shall make my stand here and...!
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
<color=#7d7d7d>汝当驱逐叛道之徒……
汝当守护黄金之色……
永恒安息的守护者啊，汝已蒙圣命加身，当以暗影遮蔽那亵渎的光芒……</color>
 <color=#7d7d7d>Thou shalt banish the apostates...
Thou shalt preserve the Golden hue...
Thou art hallow'd with the divine duty to shade the profane light, O keeper of eternal rest...</color>

等、等等……请放下武器……
 W-wait... Lower your weapons, please...
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
你们身上留下的鎏金痕迹……虽然相似，却与我们必须守护的黄金树脂截然不同。
 Your aureate traces are... while similar, quite unlike the Golden Resin we must preserve.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
是啊，那我们刚才这么解释时，你为什么不听？本来可以避免这一整场麻烦的……
 Yeah, well, why didn't you listen when we said as much? Could've avoided this whole mess...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
以实玛利威吓般朝店员逼近一步，对方立刻畏缩着后退了。
 Ishmael took a threatening stride toward the employee, who quickly shrank back.

哦！我明白了……您的声音再次在我体内回响！他们是真正的异乡人，对我们的规矩一无所知——只因我们品牌的价值而慕名至此的顾客，仅此而已。我将重新接待他们。
 Oh! I understand... Your voice resounds within me once more! These are true strangers, innocent of our ways—customers drawn here by the worth of our brand, and nothing more. I shall receive them anew.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
尊贵的顾客，请宽恕我的冒犯。笼罩着你们的金色光芒，与我们必须守护的神圣黄金树脂极为相似。
 Forgive my affront, dear customers. The golden light that hangs over you much resembles the blessed Golden Resin we must preserve.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
能像你这样感知到金枝存在的人，我们可没遇见过几个……你是怎么做到的？
 We haven't met too many people who could pick up the Golden Bough's presence like you did... How'd ya do it?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
我们每个人都能感受到那金色的脉动……并对其充满渴望。
 Every one of us feels that golden pulse... and thirsts for it.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
那是指引我们的光芒……将我们编织成理想形态的金色辉光……
 Our guiding light... The golden gleam that weaves us into our desired forms...
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
我们也渴望那份光辉。但与屈从于卑劣欲望的赤红者不同，我们漆黑者立下了永恒誓言，要守护那神圣的纹理。
 We desire it too, that brilliance. But unlike the Rouges who surrendered to their base urges, we Noirs are the eternally sworn guards of the blessed grain.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
想必你们也已经注意到了……墙上到处都是那些亵渎神圣的赤红者留下的丑陋咬痕。
 As you have doubtless noticed... The walls are riddled with the hideous bite marks left by those blasphemous red ones.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
这正是黄金树脂的纹理……可那些赤红者野蛮人，正忙着把这座坚固堡垒的本质往自己喉咙里塞……！
 Grain of the Golden Resin, indeed... But those Rouge savages are busy shoveling that very essence of the stalwart bastion into their gullets...!
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
好吧，所以……“黄金树脂”到底是什么？
 Okay, so... just what is the "Golden Resin"?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<这和金枝有什么关系吗？>
 <Does this have anything to do with the Golden Boughs?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
……我觉得他说的是这些……斑块。
 ... I think he's talking about these... patches.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
罗佳指向一面墙，墙上稀疏地覆盖着几块已经褪色的树脂。
 Rodya pointed at one of the walls sparsely covered in patches of faded resin.

所以这些就是“黄金树脂”啊……
 So they're the "Golden Resin," huh...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
那是在九个树季之前——灾难性的裂缝出现在西西弗百货的墙壁上，破灭时代就此降临。
 The time was nine arboreal Seasons ago—when the Age of Ruin descended upon Grand Magasin Sisyphe in the form of cataclysmic cracks forming upon its walls.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
就在毁灭降临前的最后一刻，救赎以只能被称作神迹的形式出现了——璀璨的黄金树脂在本会令我们破灭的裂缝中显现，将它们修补如初。我们难道不该赞美并崇拜这份天意吗？可悲的是……赤红者无法理解这番崇敬背后不容置疑的道理，反而选择剥挖墙壁……荒谬至极。
 Then, mere moments before doom took us, salvation arrived in a form that couldn't be anything else but divine—brilliant resin of gold, materializing in the cracks that would have been our ruin, patching them back to wholeness. Are we not to praise and worship this providence? Alas... The Rouges fail to comprehend the unequivocal logic in this veneration, and instead elect to flay the walls... Preposterous.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
尽管两派之间维持着岌岌可危的停战……但眼前的真相人人都看得清楚：这份和平不过是一时的喘息，仅此而已。
 Though a precarious truce between the two factions is in place... None fail to see the truth that is plainly before them: this peace is but a momentary lull, nothing more.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
到那时……唯有到那时……我的心智才会向广播之外真正的“声音”敞开。
 Then... only then... shall my mind be opened to the true "Voice," beyond the broadcast.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
……？那你刚才大谈特谈的声音又是什么？
 ...? What was all that fuss about voices earlier, then?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text: 呃……！对，确实……我的确听得到那个“声音……”我的意思是，我的心智会进一步敞开，让我能更频繁地听见它…… Uh...! Right, indeed... I do hear the "Voice..." What I meant to say is that my mind shall be opened further so that I may hear it more frequently...
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
总之……如果你知道上楼的路，能不能把这个秘密也告诉我们？
 Anyways... If ya know a way upstairs, care to let us in on the secret?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
啊，原来你们是想前往客户服务中心的顾客……
 Ah, so you are customers who seek to reach the Customer Service Center, I see...
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
向上攀升便是赢得声望，而拥有声望，便要不断花费、不断消费，直到支出与他们所要求的地位相称。
 To rise is to gain prestige, and to be prestigious is to spend and consume until your expenditure befits the status they demand.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
尽管我受职责所缚，必须留在这家店内接待顾客……
 Though I am bound to my post, to remain in this establishment and attend to its customers...
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
……也许你们能代替我登上高层，将我对黄金树脂永恒不渝的忠诚传述于众……
 ... perhaps you may be able to ascend in my stead and relay the account of my eternal fidelity toward the Golden Resin...
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
明白了。所以我们想上楼，就得花钱。要是你不介意，我还有一个问题——在这里到底要怎么赚钱？
 Gotcha. So if we want to go upstairs, we're gonna need to spend some cash. One more question, if you wouldn't mind—how exactly do we make money around here?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
……钱？
 ... Money?
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
这里对钱的叫法似乎是“眼球”……对吧？
 The lingo for money here seems to be "eyeballs"... Right?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
哦……你们这些异乡人的决心果真非同寻常。
 Oh... You strangers truly possess a determination unlike any other.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
那么，我便告诉你们获取眼球的方法。去人偶身上夺取吧。它们会抓住一切机会无休止地展示自己；只要勤勉努力，你们便能收集到所需的全部眼球。
 Then I shall reveal the means by which eyeballs may be won. Take them from the Mannequins. They seek every opportunity to exhibit themselves without end; if you apply yourselves diligently, you will gather all the eyeballs you require.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
还有一事——请务必从此处开始时刻保持警惕，因为你们将进入赤红者的领地。那些粗俗的异教恶徒甚至连一匹布都披不好，于是便撕下我们的黄金树脂，任凭喜好将其缝成种种亵渎神圣的形状……
 And another thing—pray, be constantly vigilant beyond this point, for you will be entering the territory of the Rouges. The vulgar, heathen fiends cannot even drape a bolt of fabric properly, so they rend our Golden Resin and stitch it back together in whatever blasphemous shape that pleases them...
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
……赤红者……好吧。我们会记住的。
 ... The Rouges... All right. Will keep that in mind.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
若无其他问题，勇敢的异乡人，我很荣幸地通知各位，本店现已开放，任君浏览。
 If there isn't anything else, brave strangers, I am honored to inform you that this establishment is now open to your perusal.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
我觉得这里卖的东西，我们差不多全都看过了。
 I think we've looked at pretty much everything they have to offer here.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
<这里卖的东西还真够古怪的……这里所有商店的货品都这么奇怪吗？>
 <Those are some pretty bizarre things they're selling here... Do all shops here have such a weird inventory?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
那就去前面的另一家店看看吧，到时候就知道了。
 Well, let's head to the other store up ahead and find out.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
哦……真遗憾。我们没有任何商品适合拥有你们这种……品位的异乡人。等你们对时尚有了一定理解——顺便也提升了等级——再回来吧。
 Oh... How regrettable. We carry nothing suitable for Strangers of your... sensibilities. Return once you've cultivated some understanding of fashion—and raised your rank, too.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
那我们要怎么提升等级？
 And how do we raise that?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
在百货商店中，提升地位的方法只有一个，不是吗？
 There is but one way to raise one's standing in a department store, is there not?
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
……花钱。花很多钱。
 ... Spend money. Lots of it.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
正是如此。那么，后会有期，拥有着实……引人注目的时尚品位的异乡人。
 Precisely. Then until we meet again, Strangers of truly... arresting fashion.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
欢迎光临，尊贵的顾客——
 Welcome, dear customers—
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
啊……我这是见到了一位真正的时尚鉴赏家吗？这风格与我们如此相像……精致……优雅……还有这份色彩驾驭——绝妙。
 Ah... Do I spy a true connoisseur of fashion? A style much like our own... sophisticated... elegant... and that command of color—exquisite.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
哈！看吧？终于有人懂了。
 Hah! See? Someone gets it.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
这句赞美是对经理说的。
 The compliment was directed at the Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<咦……看来用这里的说法，我还挺“潮”的？>
 <Huh... Guess I'm pretty "hip" here, as they say?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
那就……恭喜你了。
 Congrats, I guess...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
看来您拥有相当不错的时尚眼光，或许我可以就购物一事给您一些专家建议……
 You appear to possess a respectable eye for fashion, so perhaps I can offer an expert's advice on shopping...
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
我们品牌的灵魂是解放——准确地说，是令人窒息的解放。您经过漆黑者的店铺了，对吧？那些钉穿布料的钢钉，不过是在虚伪地扮演约束——赤红者的理念从根本上就与之不同。
 The soul of our label is liberation—strangling liberation, to be exact. You passed through the Noirs' store, yes? All those steel pins hammered through the fabric are a hypocritical pantomime of restraint—the philosophy of Le Rouge differs at its very root.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
请把注意力放在……这里，您看得到材料平滑自然的延展性吗？除了带齿——没错，就是字面意义上的带齿——环织工艺，其他任何生产技术都做不出这种效果。皮革顺势垂落，构成毫不费力却又无比崇高的轮廓。
 If I may direct your attention... here, do you see the smooth, natural give of the material? You won't see that from any production technique other than toothed—yes, it is quite literal—loopwheeling technique. The hide spills downward, completing a silhouette at once effortless and sublime.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text: 啊！还有一点不说可不行：这种材料中混入了0.3盎司的黄金皮革。只要亲手摸一摸——啊，它的光泽是如此迷人，简直会沿着表面闪闪发亮，不是吗？不是吗？ Ah! And I would be remiss not to share that this includes 0.3 ounces of Golden Hide blended into the material. Simply feel it in your hands—ah, it has such a wonderful luster that practically gleams along the surface, doesn't it? Doesn't it?
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
我不由得注意到，她在这番长篇大论期间一直饥渴地舔着嘴唇。
 I couldn't help but notice that she was hungrily licking her lips throughout the rant.

是、是挺亮的……
 It-it does...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
啊，请原谅……我有些忘乎所以了，是不是？
 Ah, do pardon me... I got carried away, didn't I?
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
其实，我就是这个品牌的设计师。
 The truth is, I am the designer of this label.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
天哪，为了在百货商店里争取到属于自己的这一小块角落，我克服过的种种困难，真要说起来几个小时都说不完。你要知道，在西西弗百货创立一个设计师品牌可绝非易事。
 Gosh, I could go on for hours about all the troubles I had to overcome to have this tiny corner of the department store to myself. It's no easy task launching a designer label at Sisyphe, you know.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
嗯……至少她看起来属于友善的那一类。
 Well... at least she seems to fall into the friendly camp.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
您有特别偏好的轮廓吗？如果愿意，我可以从自己的系列中为您挑选一套，将您的体形展现得尽善尽美。
 Is there a particular silhouette you're after? If you like, I can select a line from my collection that will articulate your physique to perfection.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
其实……我们是在寻找上楼的路。
 We're... trying to find our way upstairs, actually.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
上面的楼层……
 The upper floors...
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
啊，我就知道……您对豪华品牌也更感兴趣，对吧？
 Ah, I knew it... You're more interested in the Luxury brands too, aren't you?
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
但我可以向您保证，我的设计在质量标准和古典气质上，与那些豪华品牌相差并不远……
 But I assure you, the quality standards and the classique air of my designs are not so far behind those of Luxury brands...
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
当然，豪华品牌的魅力无可否认。曾经有一段时间，就连我也像着了魔一样全心收集眼球，只为争取一睹豪华厅的机会……
 Yes, of course, the allure of Luxury brands is undeniable. There once was a time when even I devoted myself to collecting eyeballs like a thing possessed, all for the chance of witnessing the Luxury Hall...
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
不，我们只是……
 No, we're just...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text: 我认识一个赤红者，那人获准加入豪华厅前曾在这里工作。我不想说坏话，但他们居然批准了一个在制版与设计上明显不如我的人，这实在令我不满。而且你敢相信吗？这个所谓的“豪华设计师”初出茅庐时，还是在我的指导下学会这门手艺的。 I know a Rouge who used to work here before they were allowed to join the Luxury Hall. I don't want to badmouth, but I do take umbrage with how they approved somebody who is so clearly my inferior in patterning and design. And to think this "Luxury designer" learned their craft under my tutelage as a greenhorn, can you believe it?
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
直到……听着，接下来的事才真的荒唐……
 Until... listen, this is where it gets really ridiculous...
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
……那人用牙齿在每一件商品的领口和下摆上整整留下了76个齿痕。也不知道顾客究竟从中看见了什么，普遍评价竟说它呈现出一种“解构式轮廓”，货架上的商品几乎被一扫而空。
 ... they used their teeth to line each and every one of their items with exactly 76 tooth marks along the necklines and hems. Whatever it was that the customers saw, the general reception claimed it cast a "deconstructive silhouette," and practically emptied their shelves.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text: 哼，归根结底不过是侥幸，我可不会把那种事归功于对方的本领……我的设计远比那人的精巧，更别提还有无可比拟的优雅。 Eh, I wouldn't attribute that to their skill when it ultimately amounts to a fluke... My designs are far more sophisticated than theirs, not to mention incomparably elegant.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
我也理应得到认可，成为一家豪华品牌。拥有属于自己的高级定制品牌！可我究竟该怎么做才能——
 I deserve to be recognized as a Luxury house, too. A couture label of my own! But just what must I do to—
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
……哦，我有了一个绝妙的灵感。
 ... Oh, I've a brilliant inspiration.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
能麻烦你们从展示人偶那里帮我取一根针吗？
 Would you mind grabbing me a needle from the Exhibiting Mannequins?
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
替我找一根够大的，我会尽量给你们足够的回报。
 Find me a sizable one, and I'll try to make it worth your while.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
那个人偶似乎比其他的更难对付……你觉得就是这根金针吗？
 That Mannequin seemed tougher than the others... Ya think it's this golden needle?
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
你们把针带来了吗？
 Have you brought me the needle?
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
好了，你要的针。那……能解释一下为什么它会是你跻身豪华品牌的关键吗？
 Yeah, here's your needle. So... care to explain how this is your key to joining the Luxury brands?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
这只是我突然想到的。我的品牌若想进入高级时装界，需要深厚传承吗？不需要。需要完美的技术吗？显然也不需要。需要稀有的高档材料吗？完全不需要……
 It's just something that's struck me all of a sudden. Does my brand need strong heritage to enter the world of high fashion? No. Technical perfection? Clearly not. Rare, high-grade materials? Not at all...
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
可我一直执着于满足那些武断的条件，结果把自己困在了这个不过是装潢华丽玻璃瓮的大厅里。
 But I've been so obsessed with meeting those arbitrary conditions that I've trapped myself in this glorified glass jar of a lobby.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text: 没错，标志性作品……我缺少的是那件标志性作品——你们明白我的意思吗？——一个只需匆匆一瞥，就能攫住每位顾客目光的独一无二的创意…… Yes, a signature piece... What I lacked was the signature piece—do you understand what I'm getting at?—the singular idea that would seize every customer's eye just from a quick glance...
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
她从我们手中接过那根巨针，将它举到与双眼齐平的位置……随后开始用它飞快地刺击自己的皮肤。
 She took the massive needle from us, raised it to her eye level... then began rapidly stabbing her own skin with it.

只要做出漂亮的图案……像这样……就能轻易营造出立体感。等着看材料各处均匀肿胀起来吧。
 If I give it a nice pattern... like so... I can easily create a sense of three-dimensionality. Just wait until you see the material swell up evenly across the board.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text: 哦，我都等不及要感受图案上的每个孔洞都被柔软多汁的脓液填满了！这样会形成无比柔顺的触感……怎么样？放在上层豪华厅的那些杰作当中也毫不逊色，对吧？对吧？ Ohh, I can't wait to feel each hole in the pattern fill up with soft, juicy pus! It'll result in such a supple touch... How's that? It'll fit right in among the masterpieces of the Luxury Hall on the upper floors, won't it? won't it?
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
我、我想应该不会逊色……
 S-sure it would, I think...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
你就只有这句话吗？你明明有一双发现美的眼睛——那就用起来！好好欣赏眼前的作品！
 Is that all you've got to say? You have an eye for beauty—use it! Appreciate what you see!
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
……横轴刺出21个孔洞，纵轴同样刺出21个，并以均匀间隔相互交叉。这样可以实现最高密度。
 ... 21 punctures along the horizontal axis and 21 along the vertical, intersecting at uniform intervals. That would produce the greatest density.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
当然……将绗缝工艺与压纹设计相结合，构成菱形的混合结构。
 Of course... A hybrid construction of the quilting process and embossed design formed into diamond shapes.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
总之，我们已经依约帮了你。现在也该由你履行交易，告诉我们要怎么上楼了。
 Anyway, we helped you out, as promised. I think it's about time you held up your end of the deal and told us how to get ourselves upstairs.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
哦，那个啊？你们只需要提升自己的声望等级。当然，以你们目前的等级，或许该先从下面的休闲装馆开始购物之旅……
 Oh, that? You simply need to build up your Prestige Tier. At your current level, of course, you should probably start your shopping journey down at the Casualwear Hall...
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
……不过，既然你们为我的时尚事业提供了这么大的帮助，我就为你们破例一次，允许你们购买我的品牌商品。
 ... But since you've been tremendously helpful in my fashion ventures, I'll make a special exception for you and allow purchase from my brand.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
<结果还是没有免费的东西啊。>
 <No freebies after all, huh.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
记住我的话：等我们下次见面时……也许你们会在豪华厅看到我，在那崇高的橱窗里展示我的作品——或者说，展示我自己。啊……何等幸福……
 Mark my words: the next time we meet... perhaps you will see me in the Luxury Hall, showcasing my piece—or shall I say, myself—in an exalted window display. Ahh... What bliss...
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
瞧瞧我，下一季系列的截止日期都迫在眉睫了，我却还在这里闲聊浪费时间……失陪一下，我得完成肩缝处的压纹……
 Look at me, wasting my time chattering away when the deadline for the next collection is fast approaching... Excuse me while I finish embossing the shoulder seam...
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
与此同时，请随意浏览我的设计师系列！所有商品都可以购买……
 In the meantime, feel free to browse my designer collection! No item is off limits for purchase...
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
这商品种类还真是……古怪。
 What a... bizarre assortment of products.

哦，又见面了！我找到了自动扶梯，可它不运行。
 Oh, hello again! I found the escalator, but it won't run.
texts.speaker:
杜博阿
 Dubois

texts.text:
真的？真奇怪，它为什么不……
 Really? That's weird, why wouldn't it...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
等等，你们一来它就开始运行了！你们一定找到了什么办法，解锁了通往上层的路！
 Wait, it's running now that you're here! You must've found a way to unlock your way onto the upper floor!
texts.speaker:
杜博阿
 Dubois

texts.text:
嗯，我们稍微买了点东西……干了点苦活……又干了更多苦活……
 Well, we did a lil' shopping... some grunt work... some more grunt work...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
我能跟你们一起走吗？我保证，一找到自己赚钱的办法，就会立刻报答你们。
 Can I tag along? I promise I'll repay you guys as soon as I find a way to make some money myself.
texts.speaker:
杜博阿
 Dubois

texts.text:
好像也没什么坏处……那就上来吧？
 Don't see what the harm could be... Hop right on, I guess?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
怎么？终于决定带我去洗手间了？
 What? Finally decided to show me to the restroom?
texts.speaker: 크로머

texts.text: 통상 대화에용
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
四处看看吧。休闲装馆迎合的是瞬息万变的潮流。面对快时尚没必要权衡选择——直接买下一件，赶在潮流过去前穿上吧！
 Take a look around. The Casualwear Hall is catered to ever-changing trends. No need to weigh your options when it comes to fast fashion—just get one and dress up before the trend goes!
texts.speaker:
米莫萨
 Mimosa

texts.text:
请稍后再来。
 Please come back later.
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
多亏你们，我终于能上楼了！我不会忘记你们为我做的一切。
 I can finally go upstairs, thanks to you! I won't forget what you've done for me.
texts.speaker:
杜博阿
 Dubois

texts.text:
还有空瓶子吗？多余的手掌也行。
 Got any empty bottles left? A spare palm would do, too.
texts.speaker:
选购眼球的顾客
 Eye-shopping Customer

texts.text:
我……觉得我们没有空瓶子，也没有……多余的手掌……抱歉……哈……哈……
 I... don't think we have any empty bottles or... spare palms... Sorry... ha... ha...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
该死。我的眼球不够买本季新系列了……
 Damn. I don't have enough eyeballs for this season's new collection...
texts.speaker:
选购眼球的顾客
 Eye-shopping Customer

texts.text:
那名顾客焦躁地啃咬着自己的指甲。
 The customer gnaws anxiously at their fingernails.

别费心跟我说话了，反正你们什么都不会借给我……
 Don't bother talking to me you're not going to lend me anything...
texts.speaker:
选购眼球的顾客
 Eye-shopping Customer

texts.text:
<……这到底是什么？>
 <... What even is this?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我觉得它……在动。就像在抽搐……而且上面到处缠着那些瘆人的结……
 I think it's... moving. Like twitching... And it's got those creepy knots tangled all over...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
还是别看得太仔细了。
 Let's not look too closely.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
一件无法辨认的展品。……还是别看得太仔细了。
 An unidentified display piece. ... Let's not look too closely.

幸好我赶在潮流退去前预约了皮肤烫卷！等他们把每一道皮肤褶皱都烫出卷曲层次，就再也没人能把目光从我身上移开了！
 Thank goodness I booked my dermal perm before the trend died! Once they layer the curl into every ridge of my skin, nobody will be able to tear their eyes away from me!
texts.speaker:
疗程顾客
 Treatment Customer

texts.text:
异乡人——别再打量我了。我的改造疗程才做到一半。就算努力看，你们也不可能认出我是谁。
 Strangers—stop checking me out. I'm halfway through my makeover treatment. You couldn't tell who I was even if you tried.
texts.speaker:
疗程顾客
 Treatment Customer

texts.text:
*叹气*我真受不了这些连疗程都买不起的穷鬼。去去去。走开。少管闲事。
 *sigh* I just can't with these bums who can't even afford these treatments. Shoo. Scram. Mind your own business.
texts.speaker:
疗程顾客
 Treatment Customer

texts.text:
别盯着我看！
 Stop staring at me!
texts.speaker:
疗程顾客
 Treatment Customer

texts.text:
我说了，别盯着我看！
 Stop staring at me, I said!
texts.speaker:
疗程顾客
 Treatment Customer

texts.text:
这股潮流最好快点过去。我的皮肤已经没有一块空白能再添一个波点了。
 This trend had better die soon. I don't have a single patch of bare skin left for another polka dot.
texts.speaker:
选购眼球的顾客
 Eye-shopping Customer

texts.text:
致迷路的顾客：
请抬起双眼欣赏赤红者系列。请将目光固定在地面上欣赏漆黑者系列。
 For Lost Customers:
Please keep your eyes raised up to enjoy the Rouge collection. Keep your eyes fixed on the ground to enjoy the Noir collection.

掉落在楼层中央的尸堆似乎已经爆裂，飞溅物一路溅到了这里。
 The corpse pile that fell in the center of the floor appears to have burst and splattered all the way over here.

目前，前方的道路被堵住了。
 For now, the way forward is blocked.

<看起来只是普通的伸缩带隔离栏。我明明应该能直接跨过去……可一旦真的尝试，就会觉得绝对做不到。>
 <It looks like an ordinary belt barrier. I should be able to step right over it... But the second I try, it feels impossible.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
这是因为我们目前身处象征界。
 That is because we are currently in the Symbolic.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
从物理结构来看，这个物体只由两根金属柱和连接它们的伸缩带组成。然而，它被赋予了禁止通行的象征功能。
 Physically, the object consists only of two metal posts joined by a retractable belt. However, it has been assigned the symbolic function of denying passage.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
就其象征意义而言，这项功能是绝对的。在这个领域中无法跨越它，经理。
 That function is absolute as far as its symbolic meaning is concerned. It cannot be crossed within this realm, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<所、所以……你们找到他们了吗？>
 <S-so... Were you able to find them?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
他们不见了……我不是说少了一两个人——除了我们之外，所有人都凭空消失了。
 They're gone... And I don't mean that like we lost one or two people—everyone except us vanished into thin air.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
别、别这样嘛～玩笑该结束了，各位，都出来吧……这、这一点都不好笑！
 C-come on~ Joke's over, everybody, come on out... Th-this isn't funny!
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
<呃，等一下……>
 <Uh, wait a minute...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<……好吧，我不知道他们那边出了什么问题，但我觉得还没必要惊慌。>
 <... All right, I'm not sure what the issue is on their side, but I don't think it's anything to panic about.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
哦！对了！但丁能看到所有人的位置。好了，其他人在哪里？
 Oh! Right! Dante can see where everyone is. All right, where are the others?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
<……他们在洗手间里。看起来正在尝试各种离开的办法，但……似乎都没什么效果。>
 <... They're in the restroom. Looks like they're trying all sorts of things to leave, but... not with much success.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
在这种情况下，他们不可能特意折返回去偷懒。也许这里存在某种特殊的规则或现象，把他们全都拖回了洗手间？
 They wouldn't have doubled back just to loaf around in a situation like this. Maybe there's some rule or phenomenon peculiar to this place that dragged them all back to the restroom?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<先去找默尔索吧。洗手间的问题……大概还能再等一会儿。>
 <Let's go find Meursault first. The restroom issue can... probably wait a little longer.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
等等。大家都去哪里了？
 Hang on. Where'd everyone go?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
也许他们落在后面了？我是说，来这里的路弯弯绕绕的，所以……
 Maybe they fell behind? I mean, the path here got pretty twisty, so...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
……也有可能。我去看看。
 ... That might be the case. Let me go check.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
以实……以实不会也消失吧？
 Ish... Ish isn't going to disappear too, is she?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
<你、你这么一说，我也开始害怕了。还是别说这种不吉利的话……>
 <N-now you're starting to scare me. Let's not jinx ourselves like that...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
必须先将人偶引导至出口，经理。接下来是以我为交换物的交易。
 The Mannequins must first be guided to the exit, Manager. Next is the transaction in which I am the object of exchange.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
走吧，但丁。我们得去把默尔索带回来。
 Come on, Dante. We need to go get Meursault.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
一座摆满无法辨认物体的陈列架。
 A display shelf full of unidentifiable objects.

标签上写着：“永不褪色的遮盖力！感受新鲜蜕皮中清爽的淋巴液！瞬间售罄！”
 The label reads: "Coverage That Never Fades! Feel the Refreshing Lymph of Freshly Shed Skin! Instant Sellout!"

……看来没有必要检查产品本身。
 ... It seems unnecessary to inspect the product itself.

<那这个又是什么？>
 <And what's this?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
看起来像美发沙龙用的加热灯。我以前见过几台。
 Looks like a salon heat lamp. I've seen a few before.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
我记得自己曾在这种灯下坐上好几个小时，想把头发拉直。显然……没有成功。
 I remember spending hours sitting under one, trying to straighten my hair. It... didn't work, obviously.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
以实玛利说这是美发沙龙用的加热灯。我怀疑它除了给我的脑袋加热，什么作用都没有。
 Ishmael called it a salon heat lamp. I doubt it would do anything beyond warming my head.

我真的很想坐在这里歇歇腿。但……救出默尔索更重要。时间紧迫。
 I'm really tempted to sit and rest my legs here. But... saving Meursault is the priority. Time is of the essence.

没时间坐着休息了。我们必须尽快找到离开这里的办法。
 No time to sit around. We need to find a way out of here as soon as possible.

……这里有一颗眼球。是谁掉的吗？
 ... There's an eyeball here. Did someone drop it?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<……这东西也会像零钱一样被人随手掉在地上吗？>
 <... Is that something people normally drop like loose change?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
那个自称是克罗默姐姐的女人说，这些眼球在这里充当货币。
 That woman who claimed to be Kromer's sister said these eyeballs function as currency in this place.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text: 所以它还真是零钱啊……？ So it is loose change, huh...?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
还没等任何人提出异议，罗佳就把眼球塞进了口袋。
 Before anyone could object, Rodya slipped the eyeball into her pocket.

……这里有一颗眼球。是谁掉的吗？
 ... There's an eyeball here. Did someone drop it?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<……这东西也会像零钱一样被人随手掉在地上吗？>
 <... Is that something people normally drop like loose change?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
那个自称是克罗默姐姐的女人说，这些眼球在这里充当货币。
 That woman who claimed to be Kromer's sister said these eyeballs function as currency in this place.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text: 所以它还真是零钱啊……？ So it is loose change, huh...?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
还没等任何人提出异议，罗佳就把眼球塞进了口袋。
 Before anyone could object, Rodya slipped the eyeball into her pocket.

我们捡到了一颗顾客掉落的眼球。
 We picked up an eyeball dropped by a customer.

我们捡到了一颗顾客掉落的眼球。
 We picked up an eyeball dropped by a customer.

一套被做成鸟形的服装。到底要怎么才能穿上？
 An attire fashioned into the shape of a bird. How is anyone supposed to put this on?

一顶帽子陈列在写有“当下潮流”的标牌下方。
 A hat is displayed beneath a placard reading, "TRENDING NOW."

杜博阿倒在地上，已经死了。
 Dubois lies dead.

你的指示已执行完毕，经理。
 Your instruction has been carried out, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……说实话，杀死一个始终善待我们的人，让我心里很不好受。
 ... I'll be honest. Killing someone who's been nothing but nice to us doesn't sit right with me.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
……我们想上楼就需要钱。
 ... We need money if we're going upstairs.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
这也是一种赚钱的办法……除非我们打算留在这里卖衣服——或者像外面那些人一样，花上一整天翻找尸体。
 This was one way to get it... Unless we plan on squatting here selling clothes—or spending the whole day rummaging through corpses like the people outside.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
不过，我不是想让但丁因为那个决定产生负罪感。他们命令默尔索那么做时，肯定有自己的考量。
 Well, I'm not trying to guilt Dante for making that decision. They must've had something in mind when they ordered Meursault to do that.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
黑色服装悬挂在聚光灯下。
 Black garments hang beneath the spotlights.

一个倒置的人偶从地面伸出。这是用来展示裤子的吗？还是袜子？
 An upside-down Mannequin juts out from the floor. Is it meant to model trousers? Socks?

<他们干嘛要摆成这么……扭曲的姿势展示啊？>
 <Why would they display it in such a... contorted pose?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
为了让上半躯干和下半躯干——包括头部与双脚——同时出现在顾客的视野中。
 To present the upper and lower body, including the head and feet, simultaneously in the customer's field of vision.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
……可这是为什么？只要让它直立着，人们自然会上下打量着看个够。
 ... But why? Just keep it standing upright, and people'll just look up and down to check it out.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
那样的话——
 That would—
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
何必那么费劲呢，以实？这样一来，整套衣服正好尽收眼底啦～
