 Why go through the effort, Ishy? This way, the whole outfit fits neatly into view~
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
……你刚才是不是正想这么说，默尔？
 ... That's what you were about to say, right, Meur?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
没错。
 Correct.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
以实玛利缓缓点了点头，像是终于接受了这地方自有一套常理。
 Ishmael slowly nodded as if she had finally accepted that this place operated on a common sense all its own.

一具倒挂的人体模特，同时展示着上半躯干、下半躯干、头部与双脚。整套衣服的确尽收眼底。
 An upside-down Mannequin that displays its upper body, lower body, head, and feet all at once. The entire outfit does fit neatly into view.
<color=#E1B643>.......</color>

一阵柔和而温暖的笑声，轻轻拂过贴在墙上的指尖。
 A soft and warm peal of laughter brushes past the fingertips laid against the wall.

一缕苍白的光，让人联想起金枝，在其表面下微微闪烁。
 A pale light, reminiscent of the Golden Bough, glimmers beneath its surface.

<……我猜到会疼……但没想到它会把你整个吞下去。>
 <... I figured it would hurt... but I didn't expect it to swallow you whole.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<你还好吗，默尔索？>
 <You good, Meursault?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
没有问题。
 There is no issue.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
*叹气* 好吧，这下算是学到教训了。它一发抖，就当作是要蓄力冲锋的警告。
 *sigh* Well, that's a lesson learned. When it trembles, take it as a warning that it's winding up to charge.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text: 那玩意儿速度真的能嗖一下冲过来啊？就那种从老远那头直接冲过来的……到底要怎么躲开啊……？ That thing can really zoom, huh? Like, all the way from the other end... How the heck are you supposed to dodge that...?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
<速度是挺快，但它中途好像没法改变方向。>
 <It's fast, but it didn't seem like it could change its direction midway.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<也许可以利用这一点来躲开碰撞。>
 <Maybe you can exploit that property to avoid collision.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<……没想到它一路跳到了首脑那里。>
 <... Didn't expect it to jump all the way to the head.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
不过它挺慢的。也没多强。
 It was pretty slow, though. And not even that strong.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
试试看吧。我觉得只要默尔索不大意，跟它打应该不会太费劲。
 Let's try. I don't think Meursault'll have a hard time fighting it unless he lets his guard down.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
嗯。
 Mm.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<该死……就那一根针，差别居然这么大？！>
 <Damn it... That one needle makes that much of a difference?!>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
嵌在它身上的那根针发出微弱的金光。多半就是这东西在强化它。
 The needle embedeed in it emitted a faint golden glow. It is likely that is the element that strengthens it.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
唔……那我们就只能买些能帮上忙的衣服了……或者跟它打的时候多加小心。
 Hmm... Then our only option is to buy clothes that can help... or exercise more caution when fighting it.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
同意。
 Agreed.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
你能行的，默尔～
 You got this, Meur~
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
一面用金色皮革修补过的墙。
 A wall patched over with Golden Hide.

那气息很微弱，但总有种和金枝相似的感觉。
 The presence is faint, but something about it feels like the Golden Bough.

这具尸体和我们之前见过的那些没什么两样。血污的眼球——看样子是从倒下的尸体上抠出来的——散落在它周围。
 This corpse is not so different from the others we've seen. Blood-slick eyeballs—apparently scavenged from the bodies that fell—lie scattered around it.

摊开的杂志上有一篇关于皮肤烫染的文章，那似乎是只有一楼才提供的特殊项目。
 The open magazine contains an article about dermal perms, a special procedure apparently offered only on the first floor.

细如针的骨头，从松垮下垂的血肉褶皱间像棘刺般突出。
 Needle-thin bones jut like thorns from folds of sagging flesh.

在寻常的衣物之间，挂着几件与外面世界截然不同的诡异物件。
 Among the ordinary clothes hang grotesque pieces unlike anything from the outside world.

这件衣服下垂的褶皱微微颤动着。这景象可算不上什么赏心悦目。
 The garment's drooping folds quiver faintly. It's not a very enticing sight.

人体模特们站在展示台上。
 Mannequins stand on display.

呃……它的眼睛一直跟着我们动来动去。
 Ugh... Its eyes are followin' us whenever we move.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
那几个打量了我们一眼，然后就把头转开了。
 Those ones gave us a once-over, then turned their heads away.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
从他们的表情来看，我们的样子已经超出了他们对视觉不适的忍耐限度。
 Their expressions suggested that the sight of us exceeded their tolerance for the visually objectionable.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<哇。这话有点伤人啊……>
 <Wow. That's kind of hurtful...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
人体模特们站在展示台上。它们的眼神可算不上适合拿来比谁先眨眼的对手。
 Mannequins stand on display. These do not have the most inviting gazes for a staring contest.

一台饮料自动贩卖机上贴着一张看起来像是百货商店楼层导览图的东西。上面大部分字迹已经因为损坏而看不清了。
 What looks like a department-store directory is glued on a drink vending machine. Damage has obscured most of the lettering.

……喂，这地图是怎么回事？我怎么看着有点奇怪……
 ... Hey, what's up with this map? Looks a bit weird to me...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
你说得对……照这张图看，这家百货商店应该比我们目前看到的要大得多、复杂得多。
 You're right... According to the diagram, the department store should be far larger and more complicated than what we've seen.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
这张地图不太可能有误。这家百货商店占据着极其庞大的空间范畴；我们所能感知到、能够抵达的地方，恐怕只占整体中极小的一部分。
 The map is unlikely to be erroneous. This department store occupies an immense spatial domain; the locations accessible to our perception likely constitute only a minute fraction of the whole.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
而且这地方据说能容纳……三亿人，是吧？
 And this place is supposed to hold... 300 million people, huh?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
哦对了，上面有没有写金枝在哪层楼？
 Oh, does it say which floor has the Golden Bough?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
怎么会有人把那种东西写进导览图里？
 Why would anyone put that in the directory?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
嘿，谁说得准呢……
 Hey, you never know...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
一台饮料自动贩卖机上贴着一张看起来像是百货商店楼层导览图的东西。上面大部分字迹已经因为损坏而看不清了。
 What looks like a department-store directory is glued on a drink vending machine. Damage has obscured most of the lettering.

一行优雅的花体字写着：“赤红者本季最大胆的前卫系列！若这份宣言都无法打动你，那说明你还没准备好领略它的壮美！”
 In elegant script: "The season's boldest avant-garde collection from Le Rouge! If its message fails to move you, you're not ready for its magnificence!"

展示台上摆着一件难以辨认的物体，红布与血肉纠缠在一起，已经分不清彼此。
 An unidentified object sits on display, red cloth and flesh snarled together beyond distinction.

哦，又一颗眼球！
 Ooh, another eyeball!
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
哇，你刚才快得跟一道残影似的。手速真快啊。
 Whoa, you were a blur. You've got fast hands, huh.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
我们捡到了一颗顾客掉落的眼球。
 We picked up an eyeball dropped by a customer.

<各位，出什么事了？>
 <Guys, what happened?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
我们出不了洗手间。希斯克利夫和堂吉诃德几乎什么办法都试过了，可……都没用。
 We can't leave the restroom. Heathcliff and Don Quixote both tried pretty much everything, but... nothing worked.
texts.speaker:
辛克莱
 Sinclair

texts.text:
那……这问题可不小啊。也许意味着只有我们才被允许出去。
 That's... a serious problem. It might mean we're the only ones allowed to go out.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
肯定有办法绕过这个限制的。
 There has to be a way to circumvent this.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
四名罪人……每层楼……
 Four Sinners... on each floor...

……那之外的时间……无法保护……
 ... time... beyond that... cannot protect...

啊啊！你就不能把话说完吗？！那到底是什么意思？！
 Argh! Can't you finish a bloody sentence?! What's that even mean?!
texts.speaker:
希斯克利夫
 Heathcliff

texts.text:
她想表达的意思似乎是，同一时间只能有四个人离开洗手间。超过这个数目，或许就会有某种风险。
 The meaning she seeks to convey appears to be that only four may exit the restroom simultaneously. Perhaps any number greater than that poses a certain risk.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
<好吧……不过算上我，不是还是三个人吗？>
 <Okay... Isn't it still three, though? Counting me?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
算上此刻不在洗手间里的默尔索，一共是四个人。
 Counting Meursault, who is currently not present in the restroom, the number adds up to four.
texts.speaker:
浮士德
 Faust

texts.text:
哦，你说得对。唔……那有没有办法改变准许出去的人选呢？
 Oh, you're right. Hmm... Is there a way to change who is allowed out then, I wonder?
texts.speaker:
鸿璐
 Hong Lu

texts.text:
恐怕不行，鸿璐小友。吾亦曾怀与汝相同之疑，方才以实玛利与罗佳二人归来之际，便欲离去……然而，那扇门不许吾通过。
 I am afraid not, young Hong Lu. I harbored much the selfsame suspicion as thee, and had sought to depart moments after young Ishmael and Rodya's return... Alas, the door permitted not my passing.
texts.speaker:
堂吉诃德
 Don Quixote

texts.text:
每层楼四名罪人。她是这么说的。
 Four Sinners on each floor. That's what she said.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
而且，我大胆猜一下……名单一旦确定，就无法更改了。我说得对吗？
 And, if I were to hazard a guess... the roster cannot be altered once it has been finalized. Am I correct?
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
她对奥提斯的推测轻轻点了点头，随后又补了一句。
 She nodded lightly at Outis's conjecture before adding another comment.

……能……更换……换层的时候……
 ... can... change... when floors... change...

……那也没办法了。我们三个先出去吧。
 ... Can't be helped, I suppose. Let's the three of us head out for now.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
嗯。诸位，多加小心。
 Mm. Remain vigilant, dear fellows.
texts.speaker:
李箱
 Yi Sang

texts.text:
<该去找默尔索了。>
 <Time to go find Meursault.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
那个人体模特看着比别的都要棘手……你们觉得是不是这根金针的缘故？
 That Mannequin seemed tougher than the others... Ya think it's this golden needle?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
看着有一英尺多长。这么大……更像是鱼叉头了。
 It looks well over a foot long. At that size... it's more like a harpoon head.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
<感觉很像……我们之前见过的那个金色树脂。>
 <It feels a lot like that... Golden Resin thing we saw earlier.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
哦。那说不定这个人体模特也是被金枝加过料的？
 Huh. Then maybe this Mannequin got juiced up by the Golden Bough too?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
<不敢打包票……不过我也这么觉得。默尔索，你先把那个捡起来行吗？>
 <Can't say for sure... but I think so. Meursault, could you grab that for now?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
管理者，这片区域还有未完成的事项。
 There is still unfinished business left in this area, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
一道熟悉的蓝光从内部透出。眼下应优先搜索周边区域。
 A familiar blue light leaks out from within. For now, searching the surrounding area should take priority.

我们应该先回洗手间集合。
 We should return to the restroom and regroup first.

我们尚未达到前往下一层所需的等级。
 We have not yet attained the rank required to proceed to the next floor.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
管理者，扶梯现在看来可以运作了。
 The escalator now appears operational, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
不过，在出发之前，还有一些事情需要了结。
 However, there are still matters to conclude before our departure.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<好吧，至少我们回来了……>
 <Well, we made it back, at least...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
执行管理者。您能看到默尔索目前所在的周围情况吗？我记得您为了援护小队里较弱的成员，觉醒了一项相当方便的能力。
 Executive Manager. Are you able to see Meursault's present surroundings? I recall you awakened a highly convenient ability in an effort to assist the more lacking members of our team.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
如果能看到什么线索，我建议我们用这些细节来定位他被关押的地方。
 If anything is visible, I propose we use those details to locate the site where he is being detained.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
哦对了。经理老兄你不是能做到吗？要是能从他那头看到点什么，应该能大大缩小搜索范围，帮我们省点事。
 Oh, right. You could do that, couldn't you, Manager Bud? If you can spot anything from his end, that oughta narrow the search down and make things easier for us.
texts.speaker:
格里高尔
 Gregor

texts.text:
<唔……我不确定从这里管不管用，不过我试试看。>
 <Hmm... I don't know if it'll work from here, but I'll give it a try.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<我好像看到了……呃，一片铺着地毯的地板？对，是地毯……前面还有一些布条……大概是衣服吧。看起来像是被摆出来展示的。默尔索一动不动地站在那儿。>
 <I think I see... uh, a carpeted floor? Yeah, that's carpet... and there are strips of fabric up ahead... Clothes, probably. Looks like they've got them on display. Meursault's standing absolutely still.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
<他好像没被绑住之类的……嗯？他旁边好像有个人……>
 <He doesn't seem to be tied up or anything... Huh? There's someone beside him...>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text: 啧。处决过去还没多久，他就让自己被抓了。这可不像他会犯的失误——而且还不止一处。 Tch. Not much time has passed since the execution, and he already allows himself to be taken captive. An uncharacteristic display of incompetence coming from him—and on multiple fronts.
texts.speaker:
奥提斯
 Outis

texts.text:
唔……地毯，还有摆出来的衣服……好吧，至少比我们之前掌握的线索多了点。
 Huh... Carpet, and clothes on display... Well, it's more than we had to go on before, at least.
texts.speaker:
格里高尔
 Gregor

texts.text:
<他看起来没受伤，也没有什么迫在眉睫的危险……我们先去找一间铺着地毯、摆着服装展示的房间吧。>
 <He doesn't look to be injured or in any immediate danger... Let's start by finding a carpeted room with clothes on display.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
嗯？你们怎么这么快就回来了？
 Hm? How did you come back so soon?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
不，我觉得这里好像出了点问题～对吧，默尔？
 No, I think somethin' went wrong here~ Right, Meur?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
没错。
 Correct.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
<……那看来“山丘”那边选错了。我们回B1层，再试一次那台扶梯吧。>
 <... "Hill" was probably the wrong choice, then. Let's go back to B1 and try the escalator again.>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
那些都是什么？
 What's all that?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
随着流行季更替而过时的衣服。
 Clothes that have fallen out of fashion due to the passing of the trend seasons.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
有人把它们收集到了这里。
 Someone has gathered them here.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
它们被藏在这么偏僻的角落里。感觉就像是有人故意把它们藏起来一样……
 They're tucked away in such an out-of-the-way corner. It almost seems like someone was trying to hide them away...
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
你也知道时尚是怎么回事嘛——就是个大轮回。说不定是有人把它们存在这儿，等着哪天再流行回来？
 Ya know how fashion is—it's one big cycle. Maybe somebody stashed 'em here until they can come back in style?
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
<这些会不会是要出售的商品？>
 <Could these be items for sale?>
texts.speaker:
但丁
 Dante

texts.text:
几乎没有证据支持这种可能性。它们没有合适的价格标签，也没有得到妥善维护，管理者。
 There is very little evidence to support that possibility. They lack proper price tags and have not been maintained, Manager.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
嘿咻……！啊，没弄到。也是，早料到了……
 Hup...! Aww. No dice. Figures...
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
你、你在干什么？
 W-what are you doing?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
当然是想拿一件啦。抱歉了默尔，能不能帮忙拿一件状态最好的？那堆衣服里还混着不少别的东西呢。
 I'm tryin' to take one, obviously. Sorry, Meur, but can ya grab whichever one's in the best shape? There's a bunch of other stuff there mixed in with the clothes, too.
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
……明白了。
 ... Understood.
texts.speaker:
默尔索
 Meursault

texts.text:
获得10颗眼球。
 Obtained 10 eyeballs.

墙壁的裂缝中藏着什么东西。
 Something is concealed within a fissure in the wall.

默尔索拾起了过时的赤红者服装。
 Meursault picked up the Out-of-style Rouge Clothing.

<只是一具尸体罢了。>
 <It's just a corpse.>

赤红者的尸体。血从她面部的窟窿中流出，头无力地垂在前方。
 The corpse of a Rouge. Blood pours from the holes in the face as her head hangs limply forward.

各种气味开始融合在一起。
 All the scents are starting to blend together.

空气中弥漫着一股陌生的香气。这里一定是香水科。
 An unfamiliar fragrance hangs in the air. This must be the perfume section.

这股气味有种说不出的诡异感。……而且正逐渐变成一种恶臭。
 There's something strange and peculiar about the smell. ... It's starting to register more as a stench.

空气中萦绕着一股苦中带甜的香气。
 A bittersweet fragrance lingers in the air.

这里的商品和一路走来展示的那些不一样。
 The merchandise here is different from what was on the displays along the way.

或许是不受欢迎的衣服？它们被随意扔在了角落里。
 Unpopular clothes, perhaps? They've been tossed carelessly into a corner.

角落里胡乱堆着一堆衣服。
 Clothes have been heaped haphazardly in the corner.

一个摆着东西展示的架子。
 A shelf with something on display.

招牌上写着：“清仓大甩卖”。
 The sign reads, "BLOWOUT SALE".

上面写着[折纸收藏系列 第92号，共5件之1]。
 It says [Origami CollectioN ° 92, 1 of 5].

一件展品，形状像是缠绕捆缚在一起的肢体。
 An exhibit shaped like a tangle of intertwined limbs.

那边……说不定那边能捡到更多？该死，我选错地方了！
 That way... Maybe there's more to gather over there...? Dammit, I took the wrong spot!
texts.speaker:
不耐烦的顾客
 Impatient Customer

texts.text:
这地方是我的。滚开！
 This spot is mine. Fuck off!
texts.speaker:
绝望的顾客
 Desperate Customer

texts.text:
哇哦，你这脾气还挺冲的啊。行行行～我们撤退撤退～
 Whoa, you're a prickly one, aren'tcha. Fine, fine~ we'll back off~
texts.speaker:
罗佳
 Rodion

texts.text:
喂！把脚抬起来。你刚才是不是踩到眼球了？！
 Hey! Lift your foot. Didn't you just step on an eyeball?!
texts.speaker:
穷困的顾客
 Destitute Customer

texts.text:
……呃，你是在跟我说话吗？
 ... Uh, are you talking to me?
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
是我看错了吗……？管他呢。那你别在那儿鬼鬼祟祟的！搞得我心神不宁！
 Did I see that wrong...? Whatever. Stop skulking around, then! You're throwing me off!
texts.speaker:
穷困的顾客
 Destitute Customer

texts.text:
……喂，你要是误会了，是不是该道个歉？*叹气* 算了，当我没说。
 ... Hey, don't you think you should apologize if you got the wrong idea? *sigh* Actually, never mind.
texts.speaker:
以实玛利
 Ishmael

texts.text:
他们看起来正忙着收集眼球。
 They seem busy collecting eyeballs.

我能看到那里有什么东西在闪烁，但现在大概不是关心那个的时候。
 I can see something twinkling there, but this probably isn't the right time to worry about that.

你该带去出口的是那些人体模特，不是我！
 You're supposed to show the Mannequins to the exit, not me!
texts.speaker:
米摩莎
 Mimosa

texts.text:
住手！好痛！
 Cut it out! It hurts!
texts.speaker:
米摩莎
 Mimosa

texts.text:
哎哟……！那是不小心的吧？
 Oww...! That was an accident, right?
texts.speaker:
杜博阿
 Dubois

texts.text:
我是不是冒犯到你了？求你了，我很抱歉。别伤害我！
 Did I offend you or something? Please, I'm sorry. Don't hurt me!
texts.speaker:
杜博阿
 Dubois

texts.text:
……！你们是顾客，还是亵渎者？！
 ...! Are you customers, or blasphemers?!
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
你们是来杀我、从我的血肉上刮下金色树脂的吗？！
 Are you here to kill me and scrape the Golden Resin from my flesh?!
texts.speaker:
古斯塔夫
 Gustave

texts.text:
有什么问题吗？是不喜欢我的标牌吗？
 What is the issue? Do you not find my label to your liking?
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian

texts.text:
用血给衣服染色？这追求可真是过时了，不是吗？真俗气。
 Dyeing clothing with blood? That's a rather outmoded fashion to pursue, isn't it? How tacky.
texts.speaker:
奎利安
 Quillian
